jobs.title: Sykepleier - 100%  Svangerskapsvikariat
jobs.description:
Er du vår nye, flotte kollega? Og syns det er praktisk med kort reisevei til jobb - kun 10 min med tog fra Oslo sentrum!

Hos oss får du jobbe med moderne velferdsteknologi og være en del av et team som setter faglig utvikling og brukermedvirkning i fokus.

Du vil bli en del av et dyktig og dedikert team med engasjerte medarbeidere, som ikke bare har en genuin lidenskap for faget, men også et sterkt samhold. Hos oss er arbeidsmiljøet preget av gode faglige diskusjoner, der vi stadig utfordrer hverandre til å utvikle oss og levere best mulig tjenester. Men vi er også opptatt av å ha det gøy på jobb!

I vår bydel har brukere en lavere gjennomsnittsalder og ofte med sammensatte utfordringer innen somatikk, rus, psykiatri eller kognitiv svikt. 

Håper du har lyst til å bli en del av vår herlige gjeng!


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Helsefaglig oppfølging og tjenesteansvarlig for dine egne brukere, tilpasset deres individuelle behov.
  • Ansvar for utarbeidelse og oppdatering av tiltaksplaner.
  • Dokumentasjon i journalsystem (Gerica).
  • Gi opplæring til nyansatte og veiledning til studenter.
  • Samarbeid med pårørende og ulike faggrupper.
  • Legemiddelhåndtering i tråd med gjeldende lovverk.
  • Arbeide tverrfaglig i enheten og i bydelen, og samarbeide med andre instanser internt og eksternt
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Offentlig godkjent sykepleier med norsk autorisasjon.
  • Har førerkort klasse B.
  • God muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk, tilsvarende minimum B2
  • Har erfaring fra hjemmetjenesten og gjerne kjennskap til velferdsteknologi.
  • Ønskelig med erfaring fra Gerica
  • Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges før ansettelse
Personlige egenskaper
  • Vi er opptatt av mangfold og tror på at ulike egenskaper styrker samarbeid og kvalitet i arbeidet.
  • Du er faglig sterk, ansvarsfull og opptatt av kontinuerlig læring og utvikling for å lykkes i denne rollen.
  • Du trives med samarbeid på tvers av fag og ulike mennesker, men at du også tar selvstendige avgjørelser.
  • Vi har som de fleste andre, nok å ta fatt i og derfor er det fint om du ikke vippes av pinnen i travle dager og klarer å tilpasse deg og være fleksibel overfor oppgaver og kollegaer
  • Personlige egenskaper vil vektlegges.
Vi tilbyr
  • Fast stilling i et godt arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte og dyktige kollegaer.
  • Todelt turnus med arbeid hver 3.helg 
  • Et moderne bydelshus på Holmlia senter med kort vei til offentlig transport, kun 10 minutter med tog fra Oslo S
  • Trivelig kantine med rimelige priser.
  • Medlemskap i Oslo kommunes bedriftsidrettslag og andre fordeler.
  • Full pensjonsdekning uten trekk fra din lønn.
  • Lønn etter Oslo kommunes regulativ, i lønnstrinn 31-44, som tilsvarer kr 605 200 - 752 900, avhengig av ansiennitet + kvelds og helge tillegg
KontaktinformasjonSuresh Siddam, +47 21802180
ArbeidsstedHolmliaveien 75
1255 Oslo
Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Oslo kommune

Referansenr.: 5172527910
Stillingsprosent: 100%
Vikariat
Startdato: 01.01.2027
Sluttdato: 31.12.2027
Søknadsfrist: 20.09.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

En grønn og inkluderende bydel er vår visjon. Vi er omtrent 1200 ansatte som hver dag jobber for ca. 39 000 innbyggere i bydel Søndre Nordstrand.

I vår organisasjon skal vi alltid sette innbyggernes behov i sentrum. Vi skal spille på lag med innbyggere, næringsliv og frivillige for å skape tilrettelagte tjenester, tilbud og opplevelser. Vi skal bidra til at bydelen vår blir en god plass å leve og bo i for alle.

Arbeidsplassene i Oslo kommune skal preges av mangfold og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile byens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, kjønnsidentitet, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. Oslo kommune legger vekt på å tilrettelegge arbeidsforholdene dersom du har behov for det.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søkere kan føres opp på offentlig søkerliste selv om søkeren har bedt om anonymitet, men dette vil du i så tilfelle få varsel om.

jobs.title: Resepsjonist 80%, Scandic Sørlandet
jobs.description:
VI HAR ROM FOR DEG
Resepsjonist som vil være der det skjer

Etter en lang dag på reise er det få ting som er mer hyggelig enn å møte et vennlig ansikt som ønsker deg varmt velkommen. Det gjør vi i resepsjonen på Scandic Sørlandet hver dag.

Resepsjonen er også hotellets naturlige møtepunkt, så du kommer til å være i sentrum av der det skjer. Vi vet ikke alltid hvilke utfordringer vi kan møte på under en arbeidsdag, men vi vet at når vi samkjører avdelingene på hotellet, så kommer alle til å slutte opp om våre gjesters ønskemål. Dette gjør vi sammen!.

**Dine arbeidsoppgaver som resepsjonist: **

  • Inn og utsjekking av våre gjester i vårt system Opera
  • Koordinere med alle avdelinger for å oppfylle våre gjesters ønsker og behov
  • Bidra til mer salg
  • Ta del i og aktivt arbeide med avdelingsmålene
  • Ta imot bookinger og hente fakturaer
  • Svare på spørsmål i fra våre gjester, både elektronisk og over skranke
  • Kassehåndtering

Vi har gode utviklingsmuligheter i vår organisasjon. Hvis du har ønske og ambisjoner om utvikling, vil du få mulighet til å vokse hos oss!

Erfaring og kvalifikasjoner som vi ønsker at du har og kan dele med oss:

  • Fagbrev som resepsjonist eller erfaring med lignende jobb innen servicebransjen
  • Snakker et av de skandinaviske språkene og engelsk flytende

Det er en fordel dersom du

  • Kjenner til hotellsystemer som Opera Cloud
  • Har erfaring med mersalg og kundebehandling
  • Disponerer bil

Personlige egenskaper vi ser etter hos deg:

  • Kvalitetsbevisst med salg og service i ryggraden
  • Operativ, fleksibel og serviceinnstilt
  • Pålitelig
  • Evne til å takle høyt arbeidspress
  • Trives med skiftarbeid

Dette er fast ansettelse i 80% stilling.

Stillingen inngår i avdelingens turnus, og inkluderer dag- og kveldsskift annenhver helg og helligdager.

Oppstart etter avtale.

Søknader vurderes fortløpende. Vi oppfordrer aktuelle kandidater til å søke så snart som mulig.

Vi verdsetter mangfold og inkludering på arbeidsplassen vår og er interessert i å lære mer om dine behov og eventuelle tilrettelegginger som kan støtte deg i å lykkes i denne rollen. Vi oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uavhengig av funksjonsnivå eller bakgrunn.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Alt starter med deg. Å jobbe på et av våre hoteller betyr å være en del av et team der omtanke, samarbeid og små øyeblikk i hverdagen gjør en forskjell. Du er med på å skape den varme, hjemmekoselig følelsen som kjennetegner Scandic – ved å være til stede, her og nå, og la detaljene telle.

Noen dager går fort, andre er mer forutsigbare – ingen dager er helt like. Men det som alltid består, er lagånden. Dere stiller opp for hverandre, løser ting når de oppstår og er stolte av å levere kvalitet – selv når tempoet er høyt. Og når dere gjør det, vil gjestene ikke bare nyte oppholdet – de får lyst til å komme tilbake.

Slik jobber vi i Scandic

Vi er på vårt beste når vi jobber sammen – på tvers av roller, hoteller og team – og fokuserer på det som virkelig gjør en forskjell i hverdagen. Våre verdier veileder oss i hvordan vi møter hverandre og hvordan vi leverer: Be Pro, Be Bold, Be Caring og Be You.

Hvis du mener at ekte gjestfrihet skapes gjennom samarbeid, jevn kvalitet og små øyeblikk gjort godt, vil du føle deg hjemme hos oss.

jobs.title: Mann i rullestol søker nye tilkallingsvikarer!
jobs.employer: ECURA BPA AS AVD REGION STOR-OSLO
jobs.description:
Har du lyst til å jobbe som brukerstyrt personlig assistent på tilkalling i Skien, med muligheter for fast stilling?

Hva er BPA? 

Brukerstyrt personlig assistanse (BPA) er en alternativ måte å organisere tjenestene praktisk og personlig bistand på for mennesker med nedsatt funksjonsevne. BPA er et likestillings- og frigjøringsverktøy, og gjennom bistand fra egne assistenter legges det til rette for at personer med bistandsbehov får et aktivt og mest mulig uavhengig liv.

Om meg og mitt behov

Jeg er en mann på 50 år som trenger assistanse til mange av hverdagslivets gjøremål både inne og ute. Jeg søker flere assistenter som kan tenke seg å jobbe som tilkalling med mulighet for fast ansettelse. Assistenten må kunne jobbe både dag, kveld og helg. Jeg er en sosial mann som liker å være ute og gjøre mye forskjellig så det vil være varierte arbeidsdager. Jeg har to fugler, så assistenter bør være trygge rundt dyr.


Jeg bor på Gulset i Skien. Her jeg bor er det behov for assistenter som kan utføre flere oppgaver i og rundt boligen min som krever at du er litt "handy".

Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet være:

  • Praktisk bistand i form av husarbeid og dyrehold

  • Bistand til personlig stell

  • Av og påkledning

  • Kjøre meg til avtaler og fritidsaktiviteter (jeg har en Caravelle med manuelt gir)

  • Tilbereding av mat

Personlige egenskaper: 

  • Godt humør

  • Punktlig

  • Pålitelig

  • Fleksibel

Personlig egnethet og kjemi vektlegges.

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Har gode norskkunnskaper 

  • Gyldig politiattest

  • Erfaring som BPA er positivt, men vel så viktig er viljen og ønsket om å lære

  • Førerkort klasse B (manuelt gir)

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfull jobb hvor du gjør en forskjell

  • God opplæring og veiledning

  • Oppfølging og støtte av erfarne rådgivere i Ecura BPA

  • Pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • Lønn etter tariffavtale: for tiden minstelønn kr. 225,4 (gjelder ved turnusarbeid, dvs. arbeidstidsordning med gjennomsnittlig 35,5 timer pr. uke i 100% stilling). For den utlyste stillingen gjelder en gjennomsnittlig arbeidstid med 35,5 timer pr uke (100% stilling).

    Ved å søke på stillingen, aksepterer du at søknad og CV videreformidles til arbeidsleder i ordningen.

Aktuelle kandidater blir intervjuet fortløpende.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ecura BPA er en landsdekkende leverandør av brukerstyrt personlig assistanse (BPA). Vi jobber for at personer med funksjonsnedsettelser skal få frihet til å leve livet slik de selv ønsker. Som arbeidsgiver er vi opptatt av trygge og stabile arbeidsforhold, god opplæring og tett oppfølging av våre assistenter. Vi har lang erfaring, høy faglig kompetanse og et stort engasjement for likestilling og deltakelse. Sammen skaper vi frihet i hverdagen – for både vedtakseiere og ansatte.

jobs.title: Ravintolatilojen siivooja, Ruka
jobs.description:
Osa-aikainen siivooja ravintolatilojen siivoukseen

Etsimme asiakkaallemme luotettavia siivoajia ravintolatilojen siivoukseen. Työnkuvasi on siivota ravintolatiloja ja työvuorot tulevat painottumaan pe-ma välillä aamu-/päiväajalle klo. 06:00-13:00, mutta on myös arkivuoroja. Osan työstä pystymme myös suorittamaan klo. 13:00 jälkeenkin, joten työajat ovat joustavat oman käytettävyytesi mukaan. Työpäivien kesto vaihtelee riippuen siivottavasta kohteesta 4-6h. 

Kanssamme sinulla on mahdollisuus neuvotella työajoistasi, työpäivien määristä viikoittain sekä työajankohdista riippuen mahdollisista muista töistä, joita teet. Työ sopiikin joustavan luonteensa takia erinomaisesti esimerkiksi henkilöille, jotka haluavat osa-aikaisia töitä tai sitten lisätunteja oman työnsä oheen. 

Jotta olisit sopiva työhön, niin täytyy sinun olla valmis siivoamaan välillä hurjaksikin lipeävien juhlien railakkaita jälkiä. Siivoustekniikat, perusperehdytyksen työhön ja uudet ammattimaiset työvälineet tulet saamaan asiakkaaltamme, joten työhön voit hakea vaikka sinulla ei vielä kokemusta siivousalalta olisikaan. Toivomme kuitenkin, että et ole helposti säikähtävää luonnetta, sillä siivoustyön tiimellyksessä voit törmätä tahraan jos toiseenkin 

Tarjolla ei ole erikseen työn puolesta majoitusta, joten ennenkuin haet työtä, niin on sinulla oltava jo majoitus tai asunto lähialueella sekä tietenkin kulkuväline, jos liikut kauempaa kuin Rukan kylältä töihin. 

Palkkaa työtehtävästä maksetaan sopimuksen mukaisesti 12,59-14€/h + lisät kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimusta noudattaen.

Töitä on tarjolla nopeimmille jo syksystä alkaen ja jatkuen ympäri vuoden sesonkeja kuitenkin mukaillen! 

In english;

Looking for someone living in Ruka or nearby to pick up extra hours in restaurant cleaning!

We are looking for reliable cleaners for our client who are interested in earning extra income through part-time cleaning work. Your job will be to clean restaurant spaces, with shifts primarily scheduled between Friday and Monday in the morning or daytime hours from 6:00AM to 1:00PM. Some tasks can also be completed after 1:00PM, making work hours flexible to fit your availability. The duration of each shift varies depending on the cleaning site, ranging from 4 to 6 hours.

With us, you have the opportunity to negotiate your working hours, the number of workdays per week, and the exact scheduling of shifts based on any other jobs or commitments you may have. Thanks to its flexible nature, this job is perfect for those looking for part-time work or extra hours alongside their primary job. 

To be suitable for this role, you should be prepared to clean up after some wild parties at times! You will receive training on cleaning techniques, a basic introduction to the job, and new professional cleaning equipment from our client, so you can apply even if you have no prior experience in the cleaning industry. jobs.title: Data Engineer in Data Product Engineering
jobs.description:
If you choose to apply, please read the job ad in full and include a short cover letter. We are most interested in hearing from the real you, so we encourage authentic applications written in your own words.

The opportunity in a nutshell

Interested in combining hands-on data engineering with close collaboration across the business? This role could be a good fit for someone with 4+ years of experience who enjoys building reliable data products and working with others to make them useful.

Role: Join as a Data Engineer in our Data Product Engineering team within Schibsted's Data & AI organization, where we build reliable, well-governed, and scalable data products used across Finance, HR, Product, Subscription, and other parts of the business.

Core tools and practices: Our everyday toolkit includes SQL and Python as core languages, together with Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, AWS, Terraform, and Git, supported by solid engineering practices around testing, documentation, CI/CD, and version control.

Company: Schibsted is home to some of the most established and widely used media brands in the Nordics, including Aftenposten, VG, Svenska Dagbladet, Aftonbladet, E24, Bergens Tidende, and Stavanger Aftenblad. Across our broader Data & AI focus, data, analytics, and AI help us build better products, support smarter decisions, and create value across those newsrooms and businesses.

Location: This role is based in Oslo or Stockholm. We work in a hybrid setup, which means this is not a fully remote role, and candidates need to reside in Sweden or Norway and be able to work from one of our offices at least 2 days a week.

Why this role: You will join a relatively new team with room to contribute, learn, and help shape how we work as we continue to build trusted data products across Schibsted.

Sounds like your kind of role? Read onWho are you?

We are looking for someone with a solid foundation in data engineering who is also excited by the opportunity to keep learning, deepen their craft, and grow together with the team.

  • You have around 4+ years of experience in data engineering or a closely related role, with a track record of building reliable data solutions in production environments.
  • Strong SQL skills are important, along with a solid understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and how to design data products that are useful, trustworthy, and maintainable.
  • You can write and debug SQL and Python yourself at a strong professional level. AI-assisted tools are welcome, but this role requires solid enough fundamentals to solve everyday engineering problems without depending totally on them.
  • On the Python side, we are looking for good software engineering fundamentals, including the ability to structure maintainable applications and apply object-oriented design principles where appropriate.
  • You have hands-on experience with dbt in production environments and solid working knowledge of the wider toolkit we use, including Airflow, Snowflake, AWS, Terraform, Git, and Python and / or similar tools.
  • You will likely enjoy this role if you are comfortable making pragmatic technical decisions in environments where requirements evolve and not everything is fully defined upfront.
  • You care about engineering quality and can contribute to practices around testing, documentation, observability, governance, and cost-efficient pipeline design.
  • Clear communication matters just as much as technical strength. We value people who can work well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, explain tradeoffs clearly, and contribute positively to team collaboration and knowledge sharing.
What's the job like?

As a Data Engineer, your job is to help us build data as a product, not just pipelines that move data from one place to another. You will create robust data models, improve the reliability and scalability of our pipelines, and help shape the engineering practices that make our data products trusted and reusable across Schibsted Media.

What you will be expected to do
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into pragmatic, well-scoped data solutions.
  • Design, build, and maintain reliable pipelines and transformations in Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, and Python.
  • Develop scalable data models that support analytics, reporting, and future AI use cases.
  • Improve technical quality through testing, documentation, monitoring, and maintainable engineering practices.
  • Contribute to good architectural and implementation decisions across the team.
  • Contribute through code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing within the team.
  • Work closely with adjacent platform and Data & AI teams to align on standards, dependencies, and shared ways of working.
What success looks like

Success in this role means growing into a confident contributor who understands our data landscape, ways of working, and stakeholder needs. Over time, that includes contributing across a mix of smaller support tasks through our weekly rotation as well as larger pieces of work, helping build reliable pipelines and data models, and developing the judgment to deliver pragmatic solutions together with the team. Depending on your experience and the needs of the work, that can mean contributing as part of a team or taking the lead on a project.

Why join us?
  • You will join a team that is still shaping its ways of working, which means there is real room to contribute, learn, and grow.
  • You will work on data products with visible impact across Schibsted, supporting both technical and non-technical users in domains such as Product, Subscription, Finance, and HR.
  • You will be part of a company whose work matters in everyday life across the Nordics, helping support trusted media brands through better data, analytics, and AI capabilities.
  • You will work in an international environment with strong trust, autonomy, and good opportunities for learning through engineering communities and collaboration across Data & AI.
Got your attention? Let us hear from you!

The application period closes on 28 September 2026. We review applications on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Humørfylt mann(37) søker BPA-assistent
jobs.description:
Hvem er jeg?
Jeg er en ung mann som søker etter ny assistent (BPA) til mitt assistent-team. Jeg bor i Bjerkreim, er rullestolbruker, samboer og bor i eget hus. Vi har 2 barn på 12 og 10 år. 
Jeg ser på meg selv som fyr med godt humør, god humor, en som liker å møte nye mennesker, og komme meg ut å være sosial. Siden jeg sitter i rullestol trenger jeg litt praktisk assistanse og noen som kan bistå meg med å utføre de oppgaver som er vanskelige for meg å gjennomføre på egenhånd.

Hvem er du?
Jeg ser etter deg som er sosial, positiv og fleksibel. Jeg trenger i dag noen som kan jobbe som tilkallingsvikar. Jeg trenger hjelp hele dagen, så fint om du har anledning til å trå til ved behov. Det er mulighet for fast stilling etter hvert for rett person.

 Hva skal du gjøre?

  • Å assistere i praktiske gjøremål
  • Å assistere til en aktiv hverdag sammen med familien
  • Å assistere meg ved trening 
  • Husarbeid
  • Handling og matlaging
  • Assistere ved sosiale aktiviteter
  • Assistere ved personlig stell og hygiene 
  • Assistere når jeg skal på jobb
  • Evt være med på ulike reiser og turer

 Hva kreves?

  • Like å jobbe selvstendig og effektivt
  • Være i stand til å assistere ved forflytning
  • Håndterer både aktive og rolige dager
  • Krav om førerkort klasse B
  • Fremlegge politiattest før oppstart
  • Prate bra norsk

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfull jobb der du gjør en forskjell i hverdagen hans.
  • God opplæring og veiledning.
  • Fleksibilitet med tanke på deltid eller fulltidsstilling.
  • Lønn etter tariff.

Aktuelle kandidater vil fortløpende bli innkalt på intervju. 

Medvind assistanse BPA vil være din arbeidsgiver, og jeg vil være din arbeidsleder.

Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt. 

Jeg kan garantere deg en arbeidsdag som er fylt av varierende oppgaver, nye opplevelser og mye humor. Håper å høre fra nettopp deg.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg?
Søk da vel!


Medvind Assistanse AS er et norskeid selskap som leverer likestillingsverktøyet BPA for mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon. For funksjonsvarierte skal BPA bidra til å til å gi mulighet til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv med fokus på selvrealisering og samfunnsdeltakelse. BPA handler like mye om friheten til å kunne velge hvilket liv man vil leve, og hvem man vil være. Med BPA skal man i størst mulig grad kunne ivareta plikter, interesser, behov og ønsker som alle andre samfunnsborgere. Medvind Assistanse AS ble stiftet i 2020 og har lokale kontorer i store deler av landet.

I henhold til offentleglova § 25, kan opplysninger om søker unntas i offentlig søkerliste dersom søkeren selv ber om det. Det gjøres oppmerksom på at en søknad kan bli gjort offentlig selv om søkeren har bedt om å ikke bli ført opp søkerlista. Søkeren vil i tilfellet bli varslet om dette.


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Ringsaker kommune er med sine om lag 36.000 innbyggere den klart største kommunen i Innlandet. Kommunen har vekst i folketall og arbeidsplasser og et offensivt næringsliv som satser og ønsker utvikling. Ringsaker er Norges største hyttekommune, og Sjusjøen er kjent for å ha Norges beste skiløyper. Småbyene Brumunddal og Moelv har urbane kvaliteter, og det er et mangfoldig botilbud i hele kommunen. Det er gode oppvekstmiljøer, god barnehagedekning og en satsing på økt læringsutbytte i skolen. Mjøsa og det vakre kulturlandskapet gir fantastiske muligheter for rekreasjon og opplevelser. Vil du jobbe i en av Norges mest offensive kommuner? Som arbeidstaker i Ringsaker, blir du en del av et stort og sammensatt fagmiljø med gode kollegaer. jobs.title: Barbier / Barbière recherché(e) en Norvège
jobs.description:
The Blending Barber est un barbershop moderne situé près du fjord d'Oslo, en Norvège. Nous recherchons un barbier(e) qualifié, passionné par son métier. Les candidats de l'Union européenne sont les bienvenus.

Barber wanted for a modern barbershop in Norway. EU and Schengen applicants welcome.

Hva vi ser etter

Nous recherchons une personne qui aime le contact avec la clientèle et qui est fière d'offrir un service de grande qualité.

Vous savez communiquer avec les clients, créer une ambiance chaleureuse et mettre chacun à l'aise dès son arrivée.

Vous êtes fiable, professionnel(le) et appréciez le travail en équipe.

Une expérience en tant que barbier ou coiffeur pour hommes est indispensable. Vous devez être capable de communiquer en anglais avec les clients et l'équipe.


We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys working with people and takes pride in delivering outstanding customer service.

You communicate confidently with customers, create a welcoming atmosphere and make people feel comfortable from the moment they walk through the door.

You are reliable, professional and work well as part of a team.

Experience as a barber or men's hairdresser is required. English is required. Norwegian is an advantage but not essential.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Prestations de barbier, notamment des coupes classiques, des dégradés a blanc, des tailles de barbe, des rasages traditionnels à la serviette chaude et du coiffage.

Accueillir les clients, les conseiller avec professionnalisme et contribuer à créer une ambiance chaleureuse et conviviale au salon. Veiller au respect des normes d'hygiène et participer au bon fonctionnement quotidien du barber shop.

Provide a wide range of barbering services including classic haircuts, fades, beard trims, traditional hot towel shaves and styling.

You will welcome customers, provide professional advice and help create a relaxed and friendly atmosphere in the shop. Maintaining a high standard of hygiene and contributing to the daily operation of the barbershop are also important parts of the role.

Vi tilbyr

  • Contrat à durée indéterminée au sein d'un barber shop moderne en pleine croissance

  • Salaire attractif selon l'expérience et les qualifications

  • Prime basée sur les performances

  • Une clientèle fidèle et un poste de travail entièrement équipé

  • Des opportunités de développement professionnel

  • Un environnement de travail international, positif et convivial

  • Une aide à l'installation en Norvège, lorsque cela est applicable

  • Un employeur parlant couramment le français et l'opportunité d'améliorer votre anglais dans un environnement de travail international.

Candidature

Merci d'envoyer votre CV et votre lettre de motivation à theo.sole@wintermark.no

  • Permanent employment in a modern and growing barbershop

  • Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications

  • Performance based bonus opportunities

  • A loyal customer base and a fully equipped workplace

  • Opportunities for professional development

  • A positive international working environment

  • Support with relocation to Norway when relevant

How to apply

Please send your CV and cover letter to theo.sole@wintermark.no

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The Blending Barber est un barber shop moderne situé à Tofte, près du fjord d'Oslo. Nous associons un savoir faire de qualité à un service client irréprochable dans une ambiance chaleureuse et conviviale.

Notre concept a été mis en avant par les médias nationaux. Depuis trois ans, nous accueillons régulièrement des barbiers et coiffeurs venus de France, ce qui nous permet d'offrir un environnement de travail international et une intégration en douceur.

Candidature

Merci d'envoyer votre CV et votre lettre de motivation à theo.sole@wintermark.no

The Blending Barber is a modern barbershop in Tofte, Norway. We combine high quality barbering with outstanding customer service in a relaxed and welcoming environment. Our concept has been featured by national media, and we are proud to welcome both local and international employees.

jobs.title: Kombinert Utleierepresentant (heltid)
jobs.description:
Arbeidssted: Kjevik lufthavn, Kristiansand sentrum, Sørlandsparken

Arbeidstid: Rullerende vaktplan (dag, kveld og helg)

Oppstart: Etter avtale

Stillingsprosent: 100%

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som kombinert utleierepresentant er du ansvarlig for å levere våre tjenester på en best mulig måte til våre kunder. Hverdagen består av utstrakt kundekontakt både ansikt til ansikt og pr. telefon og mail. Vi leverer en service hvor kundens behov alltid er i fokus. Videre er du også ansvarlig for at våre leiebiler er klargjort og vasket i henhold til vår standard. Du har også ansvar for produkter (barneseter, skistativ mm), skaderegistrering, oppfølging av servicer og dekkomlegg. Logistikk, klargjøring, salg og kundeservice er kjernen i hverdagen. 

  • Klargjøring av utleiebiler (vask mm)

  • Oversikt og kontroll på skader, servicestatus og dekklager

  • Skifte dekk ved dekk omlegg

  • Yte utmerket kundeservice i alle situasjoner 

  • Presentasjon og innsalg av våre produkter til kunde på en best mulig måte

  • Håndtere telefon og epost henvendelser 

  • Organisere daglige reservasjoner i forhold til tilgjengelig flåte

  • Rapportering og annet forefallende kontorarbeid

Kvalifikasjoner

Som kombinert utleierepresentant er du den våre kunder møter hver dag. Du representerer Sixt Bilutleie og er genuint opptatt av service og trives med kundekontakt. Vi stiller høye krav til våre produkter og hvordan vi presenterer disse, med ett ønske om å overgå kundens forventinger. Du har også ansvar for standarden på produktet vi leverer. Hverdagen styres av kundens behov, og din evne til å arbeide hurtig og nøyaktig er avgjørende for den kvalitet vi leverer. Ved å levere en premium opplevelse, er du med å bygger Norges beste bilutleiekjede.    

  • Minimum førerkort klasse B (manuelt og automatgir)

  • Plettfri vandel (Politiattest)

  • Genuin serviceinnstilling og gode mellommenneskelige ferdigheter

  • Gode salgs ferdigheter

  • Hurtig og nøyaktig med stor arbeidskapasitet (også ved fysisk arbeid)

  • Strukturert og evne til å styre logistikk i en stadig skiftende/hektisk hverdag

  • Flytende norsk / engelsk muntlig og skriftlig

  • Datakunnskaper (Microsoft Office). 

Vi tilbyr

Som ansatt i Sixt Bilutleie vil du være del av en organisasjon med flinke kolleger som alle ønsker å yte det beste for våre kunder. Som del av et team vil din innsats utgjøre en forskjell, og verdsettes deretter. Vi har gode trenings- og utvekslingsprogram som alle våre ansatte følger. For den rette vil det også være utviklingsmuligheter innen organisasjonen. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sixt Bilutleie er en internasjonal bilutleiekjede med 4500 utleiestasjoner i 118 land.  Sixt er verdens største BMW kunde og er kjent for å tilby premium biler i hele verden. Sixt er en premium utleiekjede med sterkt fokus på service, kvalitet og sikkerhet.  I Norge har vi 70 utleveringssteder og er til stede på alle de store flyplassene. Sixt i Norge har mer enn 50 års erfaring med mobilitet, og har drevet en landsdekkende kjede i 20 år. Det er Autoleie AS konsernet som har franchise rettighetene for Sixt i Norge, og har hovedkontor i Kristiansand. Konsernet er opptatt av å drive en sunn drift og har levert bransjens beste resultater de siste årene.

  • Leverer kvalitetsarbejde og har sans for detaljer

  • Er stabil, positiv, motiveret og klar til at tage fat

  • En spændende og alsidig hverdag med varierende opgaver

Send din ansøgning og CV til info@ryslingetag.dk
Fortæl gerne lidt om dig selv, din erfaring og dine kvalifikationer. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet de rette kandidater. 

Lidt om os
Hos Ryslinge Tagdækning A/S brænder vi for godt håndværk og tagløsninger af høj kvalitet. Vi er et erfarent team af ca. 70 dedikerede medarbejdere, som hver dag arbejder sammen om at levere professionelle tagpapløsninger over hele landet. Vi lægger stor vægt på et godt arbejdsmiljø, faglig udvikling og en uformel omgangstone, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

UK VERSION

Experienced Roofers Wanted for Roofing Felt Work
Ryslinge Tagdækning A/S is looking for skilled and motivated roofers to carry out work with flat roofs. If you have experience working with roofing membranes and take pride in delivering high-quality workmanship, you may be the colleague we are looking for.

About the Job
We carry out roofing felt installations on new construction projects, renovation projects, and commercial buildings throughout Denmark. You will become part of a professional team where cooperation, craftsmanship, and quality are at the core of everything we do.

We Expect You To:

  • Have experience in the roofing trade and roofing felt installation

  • Deliver high-quality work with attention to detail

  • Be reliable, positive, motivated, and willing to work hard

  • Hold a valid driving licence (Category B)

  • Possess the required fire safety certificate/training for roofers

We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and employment conditions, including a pension scheme

  • A workplace with skilled and dedicated colleagues

  • A varied and exciting working day with diverse tasks

  • A positive working environment where we support and help each other

  • The opportunity for permanent employment in a well-established company with proper working conditions

Interested?

Please send your application and CV to info@ryslingetag.dk.
Feel free to tell us a little about yourself, your experience, and your qualifications.
We review applications on an ongoing basis and will hire as soon as we find the right candidates.

About Us
At Ryslinge Tagdækning A/S, we are passionate about quality craftsmanship and high-quality roofing solutions. We are an experienced team of approximately 70 dedicated employees who work together every day to deliver professional roofing felt solutions throughout Denmark.

We place great importance on a positive working environment, professional development, and an informal company culture where colleagues support one another and work together as a team.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



Safran Aircraft Engines conçoit, produit et commercialise, seul ou en coopération, des moteurs aéronautiques civils et militaires aux meilleurs niveaux de performance, fiabilité et respect de l'environnement. La société est notamment, à travers CFM International*, le leader mondial de la propulsion d'avions commerciaux courts et moyen-courriers.

Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.

PROJECTS AND DELIVERABLES

o Inventory IT / Data hardware and software. Implementation of tools to track inventory to optimize spare parts management and cost. Plan obsolescence / replacement based on Safran Standards and OEM recommendations.

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Laser-Induced Graphene (LIG) Sensors for Composite Materials
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://youtu.be/Xt-yHCN5QS0About the position

We have a new vacancy for a 3-year PhD position at ASEMlab, NTNU Gjøvik, funded by Horizon Europe projects. The PhD candidate will work with NTNU's laser-induced graphene (LIG) sensing line developing a LIG sensor system for in-situ process monitoring of fibre reinforced composite systems, and maturing it from lab-scale prototypes to integration in demonstrators. The LIG system will be developed and benchmarked alongside complementary sensing technologies. This is a doctorate at the intersection of functional 2D materials, printed electronics, industrial composites manufacturing and structural health monitoring.

The position is hosted by ASEMlab – the Laboratory of Advanced and Sustainable Engineering Materials (www.asemlab.no) at the Department of Manufacturing and Civil Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, NTNU – Norwegian University of Science and Technology, Gjøvik campus. ASEMlab performs research on polymers and composite materials across their full life cycle: advanced manufacturing, structural health monitoring and sensing, non-destructive evaluation, durability and ageing, recycling and circularity, and sustainability assessment. The laboratory operates extensive infrastructure including manufacturing, sensor development, laser systems, thermal and physico-chemical analysis (DMA, TGA, FTIR, dielectric spectroscopy), mechanical and thermomechanical fatigue testing, accelerated ageing facilities, micro-CT, CMM, ultrasound imaging, etc.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.


Duties of the position
  • design and fabricate laser-induced graphene sensors and sensor arrays (temperature, strain, pressure) using ASEMlab's laser-processing infrastructure
  • characterise and calibrate the sensors electromechanically, structurally, thermally, morphologically, etc., using advanced analytical techniques, and benchmark them against complementary sensing technologies (e.g. fibre optics)
  • develop the LIG sensor system for process monitoring and structural health monitoring
  • implement the data-acquisition chain and data-import protocols as well as analyze sensor data for different needs 
  • Work closely with interdisciplinary teams of internal and external researchers specializing in sensor technologies, materials science, data analytics, etc.
  • analyze data and publish results in leading international journals and present at conferences, contribute to project deliverables, training workshops and dissemination activities

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme (link), see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in materials science/engineering, electronics/mechatronics, applied physics, nanotechnology, mechanical/manufacturing engineering or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • demonstrated hands-on experience working in a research laboratory environment, including the safe handling of chemicals and operation of scientific instrumentation
  • strong foundational understanding of solid-state physics/chemistry and materials characterization techniques (such as Raman spectroscopy, SEM, or XRD)
  • hands-on experimental skills within sensors or functional/printed materials
  • very good written and oral English skills (documented per NTNU requirements for non-native speakers)
  • proven ability to work independently, manage a research project timeline, and collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in English

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • experience in the design, fabrication, or characterization of electromechanical sensors, printed/flexible sensors, or graphene/2D and carbon-based functional materials 
  • hands-on experience with laser synthesis, laser micromachining, or optical systems, including CO₂ or UV laser platforms commonly used for LIG fabrication
  • experience with electronics prototyping, instrumentation and data acquisition tools (Python, LabVIEW), electrical characterization hardware (e.g., source meters, potentiostats, impedance analyzers) and basic signal processing, while interest in machine-learning-based process control is a plus
  • knowledge of fibre-reinforced polymer composites and their manufacturing processes
  • experience with electrical/electromechanical characterisation techniques (e.g. impedance spectroscopy, DIC-coupled strain sensing)
  • willingness to travel for test and demonstration campaigns for project needs in Europe 

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and a strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
  • proactive, self-driven, structured and rigorous in experimental work
  • collaborative and team-oriented mindset suited to a university lab and a large industrial consortium with firm deadlines
  • strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • curiosity and ambition to publish at a high international level

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer

Evaluate and remove/add what is relevant for the position.

  • An exciting job with an important mission in an international, EU-funded project consortium
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 550 800,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering Science Doctoral Programme - PhD - Faculty of Engineering Science - NTNU within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The engagement is to be made in accordance with the regulations in force concerning State Employees and Civil Servants, and the acts relating to Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Candidates who, by assessment of the application and attachments, are seen to conflict with the criteria in the latter law will be prohibited from recruitment to NTNU.

Please note that the candidate holding the announced position is expected to work with critical infrastructure and areas subject to controls on the export of strategic goods, services and technology. Candidates with the potential of not fulfilling the requirements for security clearance, access clearance and authorization as described in the Act Relating to National Security, the Export Control Act and the Act on the Implementation of International Sanctions (Sanctions Act) cannot be considered for the position.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • CV and certificates/diplomas (BSc and MSc) with grade transcripts; diplomas in other languages must be accompanied by certified English translations
  • a motivation letter (max 2 pages) describing your suitability for and interest in the position
  • MSc thesis (or a draft if not yet completed) and any publications or other relevant research output
  • documentation of English language proficiency (e.g. IELTS/TOEFL) where applicable
  • names and contact details of at least two referees


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Sotirios Grammatikos, Director of ASEMlab, Department of Manufacturing and Civil Engineering, NTNU Gjøvik. E-mail: sotirios.grammatikos@ntnu.no

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Advisor Kristine Rognlid Hagaseth kristine.r.hagaseth@ntnu.no 

Application deadline: 11.09.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 
 

Gjøvik, a charming town by the shores of Lake Mjøsa, is known for its beautiful nature and rich cultural offerings. The town boasts a vibrant community with excellent schools, modern healthcare services, and a variety of recreational activities. With its strategic location, just a short drive from Oslo, Gjøvik combines the best of urban life and natural experiences. Here, you'll find a dynamic business environment and exciting career opportunities in a setting that values work-life balance. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

jobs.title: Waitress
jobs.description:
About Us

Tandoori Twist is an offering from Tinyhus Cafe, a child-friendly cafe in Copenhagen, Denmark, serving authentic Indian delicacies. 

We serve not only classic favourites like butter chicken and biriyani, but also lesser known Indian regional food, with myriad of spices and flavours as our specilities.

Our cafe Tinyhus serves continental food, also traditional local cuisines for events and catering. 

We strive to provide authentic food and exceptional service to our guests and we look for team members who are self-motivated, proactive and passionate to walk the extra mile to provide exceptional culinery experience for our guests. 


Our people, just like our food, are the ambassadors of our cafe and restaurant. If you like challenges and you are looking for a place where you can contribute positively, overcoming the odds of a new but growing restaurant, then please do get in touch; we will look forward to hear from you.

Job Description

Are you a proactive person who enjoys interacting with people, understands their preferences and needs and provides service with a smile? Do you have experience in making coffee and simple cocktails?

Tandoori Twist, a newly established but growing Indian Take-away and Restaurant located in Copenhagen, looking for team member who is outgoing and hard-working. If you have experience as a waiter / waitress and bartender, especially in Asian / Indian restaurant and are proactive, quick-learner, have a pleasant and outgoing personality and can take ownership of tasks, then please feel free to contact us.

Only applications through our career site will be considered https://www.tandooritwist.dk/tandooritwist-career/.


Job description

Your task will be to welcome our guests when they visit the restaurant. You will handle the orders, guide the guests if they need any recommendation, serve food, prepare and serve drinks, take payments, clean the tables and handle take-away deliveries prepared in the kitchen. You will have to make basic cocktails and coffee and serve.

In addition, there is cleaning of our premises and facilities on an ongoing basis and during the opening and closing hours.

This is a part-time position. The work is mainly in the evening and also during weekends. Please note that you need to have right to work in Denmark as work-permit will not be sponsored for this position.


Requirements

Your profile:

• You have a high level of fluency in English (Understanding Danish is an advantage but not mandatory)

• You have a pleasant, outgoing personality and you care for polished and professional appearance

• You remain calm under pressure

• You are truly passionate about high level of customer service, energetic, smiling and attentive

• You truly enjoy customer interaction and have experience in customer-facing sales activity

• Prior experience as a waitress / waiter in a restaurant is mandatory

• Prior hands-on experience either as a Barista and / or as a Bartender is preferred

• You are proficient in making basic cocktails

• Experience in making different types of coffee is desirable; however, if you do not have experience in handling manual coffee machine, you are eager to learn within a short time

• You are a proactive person who takes responsibility and hands-on ownership of the tasks and flexible when it comes to responsibilities and tasks typical for a small but growing organisation

jobs.title: Norge søker en nasjonal ekspert til Hybridsenteret i Helsingfors
jobs.description:
Om stillingen

Hybridsenteret utfører policyarbeid som støtter medlemslandene i å forstå og håndtere utfordringene som hybride trusler skaper. Arbeidet innebærer blant annet å utarbeide selvstendige analyser, bestille og administrere analytiske prosjekter blant annet fra akademia, og presentere Hybridsenterets arbeid på konferanser og webinarer.

Den norske stillingen vil være særlig rettet mot hybride trusler i nordområdene og vil spille en viktig rolle i forbindelse med Hybridsenterets arbeid på dette feltet.

Sikkerhetspolitisk avdeling i Utenriksdepartementet vil ha arbeidsgiveransvaret og koordinere den faglige oppfølgingen av den nasjonale eksperten.


Ansvarsområder og oppgaver

Som sekondert nasjonal ekspert til Hybridsenteret vil du ha følgende ansvar og oppgaver:

  • Utarbeide analyser og kunnskapsgrunnlag om hybride trusler i Arktis
  • Videreutvikle kompetansen på hybride trusler i Arktis i samarbeid med leder, basert på spesifiserte behov for nøkkelkompetanse og utviklingen i regionen
  • Presentere forskning i regi av Hybridsenteret på internasjonale konferanser, webinarer og policybrifinger
  • Bygge nettverk med representanter for medlemslandene, akademiske fagmiljøer og andre relevante aktører

Kvalifikasjoner

For å være kvalifisert må du

  • ha utdanning på minimum mastergradsnivå innen internasjonale relasjoner, statsvitenskap, økonomi, etterretning, studieretninger med fokus på nordområdene eller annet relevant område
  • ha minimum tre års arbeidserfaring fra relevante fagområder
  • ha meget gode skriftlige og muntlige kommunikasjonsevner på engelsk
  • være norsk statsborger
  • kunne sikkerhetsklareres for NATO SECRET

Det er ønskelig at du har

  • bakgrunn fra sikkerhetspolitiske spørsmål, inkludert hybride trusler
  • Internasjonal arbeidserfaring

Vi tilbyr

I denne stillingen vil du få muligheten til å

  • bidra i arbeidet med aktuelle sikkerhetspolitiske utfordringer i Arktis
  • bli en del av et ledende internasjonalt fagmiljø på hybride trusler
  • utvikle faglige og personlige nettverk
  • få verdifull arbeidserfaring fra en internasjonal organisasjon

Stillingen er en midlertidig ansettelse i inntil tre år på vilkår som følger retningslinjene for nasjonale eksperter til EU, etter avtale med Utenriksdepartementet.


Om deg

For å lykkes i stillingen er det viktig at du

  • arbeider selvstendig og strukturert
  • bygger sterke relasjoner og nettverk på tvers av fagmiljøer og landegrenser
  • er god på formidling av komplekse problemstillinger
  • har gode samarbeidsevner og er fleksibel
  • har høy personlig integritet og høy etisk standard

Vi vil legge vekt på personlig egnethet.


Behandling av personopplysninger ved søknader til Hybridsenteret

Når du søker på sekonderingen til Hybridsenteret gjennom Norec, må vi sende opplysninger om deg videre til de rekrutterende departementene (Forsvarsdepartementet, Justis- og beredskapsdepartementet og Utenriksdepartementet) og til HR-representanter ved Hybridsenteret. Søknaden, CV-en og vedleggene må derfor være på engelsk.

Ved å søke på stillingene samtykker du til at vi kan dele personopplysningene dine, inkludert CV og vitnemål, med disse partene i rekrutteringsprosessen. Filene blir kryptert og passordbeskyttet før de sendes fra Norec, for å ivareta sikkerheten til personopplysningene dine.

Har du spørsmål til hvordan vi behandler personopplysningene dine, kan du kontakte oss på fn_stillinger@norec.no
 

Du kan be om å bli unntatt fra den offentlige søkerlisten. I så fall må du begrunne ønsket. Vi kontakter deg dersom ønsket ditt ikke blir innvilget.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Hybridsenteret i Helsingfors er en autonom, nettverksbasert internasjonal organisasjon som arbeider for å styrke sikkerheten i medlemslandene ved å motvirke hybride trusler. Senteret ble etablert i 2017 og er åpent for alle medlemsland i EU og NATO. I dag har senteret 35 medlemsland. 

Hybridsenteret legger til rette for og binder sammen arbeidet i medlemslandene samt i EU og NATO, og legger til rette for samarbeid om hybride trusler blant annet gjennom felles øvelser. Disse inkluderer scenarioer der hybride trusler benyttes under terskelen for væpnet konflikt, og som ledd i krigføring. 

I tillegg til å tilby ekspertise, opplæring og nettverk, utvikler Hybridsenteret strategier og bidrar med implementering av disse. Senteret støtter også nettverk som går på tvers av stater og sektorer i medlemslandene.

Norge har vært medlem av Hybridsenteret siden høsten 2017. 

Mer informasjon finnes på Hybridsenterets hjemmesider.

Medlemsstatene kan sekondere nasjonale eksperter til senteret. Utenriksdepartementet, Forsvarsdepartementet og Justis- og beredskapsdepartementet har besluttet å etablere en norsk stilling ved senteret fra januar 2027. Stillingen har en varighet på inntil tre år. Arbeidsstedet er i Hybridsenterets moderne kontorlokaler i sentrum av Helsingfors. Senteret tilbyr et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø og har et internt opplæringsprogram for alle ansatte.

jobs.title: Payroll Controller, Norway
jobs.description:
Company Description

Radisson Hotel Group is one of the world's largest hotel groups with ten distinctive hotel brands, and more than 1,500 hotels in operation and under development in 95+ countries. The Group’s overarching brand promise is Every Moment Matters with a signature Yes I Can! service ethos.

People are at the core of our business success and future. Our people are true Moment Makers and together we bring the culture, spirit, environment and opportunities that empower you to be your best, every day, everywhere, every time. Together, we make Every Moment Matter.

Job Description

We are now looking for a Payroll Controller to join our finance team in Radisson Hotel Group!

As our Payroll Controller, Norway, you will play a key role in ensuring accurate, timely and compliant payroll across our Norwegian entities. Working closely with HR, Operations, Accounting, HR Tech/IT and our external payroll provider, you will bring strong Norwegian payroll expertise, robust controls and a continuous-improvement mindset to the end-to-end payroll process.

This is a role where your expertise will make a real difference. You will act as the key point of contact for Norwegian payroll, ensuring quality and compliance while identifying opportunities to simplify processes, reduce risk and improve the employee experience.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the monthly pre- and post-payroll control process, reconciling variances and driving corrective actions with external payroll provider.
  • Ensure accurate calculation and processing of salaries, overtime, allowances, holiday pay, leave balances and statutory deductions.
  • Calculate HR provisions and accruals and manage monthly payroll allocations.
  • Validate employee master data, employee lists and cost-allocation structures.
  • Ensure full compliance with Norwegian payroll legislation and applicable collective agreements.
  • Oversee key Norwegian payroll processes, including NAV sick pay applications and refunds, pension reporting, AFP/AGA and A-melding submissions.
  • Act as the key contact for auditors, statistical reporting and external payroll-related enquiries.
  • Manage the relationship with our external payroll provider, including SLA follow-up, quality management, escalation of issues and reduction of rework and additional service charges.
  • Coordinate Timeplan – payroll provider – SAP integration topics, including interfaces, field mapping, testing and defect resolution.
  • Own monthly reconciliations of payroll-related balance sheet accounts and ensure aged items are investigated and cleared.
  • Import and validate statistical metrics in SAP and perform plan-versus-actual checks.
  • Maintain and strengthen the payroll control framework, including master-data changes, payroll calendars and approval processes.
  • Identify end-to-end process gaps and drive continuous improvement, efficiency and risk reduction.
  • Ensure key Norway payroll consolidation milestones are delivered accurately and on time.
  • Provide functional input and expertise for the 2027 payroll tender.
  • Provide clear timelines, checklists and expectations to hotel PMs/HODs, HR and Finance stakeholders.
  • Deliver targeted training and guidance to relevant stakeholders on payroll processes and requirements.
  • Build strong working relationships across HR Norway, Operations, Controlling, Accounting, HR Tech/IT and external payroll provider.
Qualifications
  • 3-5+ years of relevant Norwegian payroll experience, ideally covering payroll across multiple entities or locations.
  • Expert knowledge of Norwegian payroll legislation, statutory requirements and collective agreements.
  • Strong experience with Timeplan, payroll systems and SAP, or comparable ERP systems.
  • Strong understanding of payroll controls, reconciliations and accounting principles.
  • Experience managing or coordinating with an external payroll provider.
  • Experience with payroll systems integration and working with interfaces, data mapping, testing and issue resolution.
  • Strong analytical skills and a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage recurring deadlines and multiple stakeholders.
  • Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to explain payroll matters to both HR and non-finance stakeholders.
  • A proactive continuous-improvement mindset, with the ability to identify issues and turn them into practical solutions.
  • Experience with project delivery or payroll transformation would be an advantage.
Additional Information

Why Join Radisson Hotel Group?

Live the Magic of Hospitality - Be part of a team that creates exceptional experiences and memorable moments every day. Let your Yes I Can! spirit shine as you bring hospitality to life.

Build a Great Career - No matter your background or experience, we invest in your growth, learning, and career development - helping you reach your full potential.

Experience the Team Spirit - Join a workplace that’s inclusive, fun, and meaningful. We celebrate diversity, support one another and foster a sense of belonging through our Employee Resource Groups and inclusion initiatives.

Lead with Your Ambition - Your ideas, passion and drive matter! We empower you to make a difference—in hospitality, your community and beyond.

Enjoy Global & Local Perks - No matter where you’re located, you’ll enjoy exclusive global benefits - like special hotel rates for you and your loved ones at our hotels worldwide. Plus, you’ll have access to local perks and rewards tailored to your country, making your experience even more rewarding!

Enjoy benefits such as - up to 53% off your stay as a Team Member at over 1,500 Radisson Hotels worldwide
Guaranteed minimum of 30% off for your Friends & Family
Exclusive Discounts on Breakfast, Food & Beverage, Spa and more

Join us in shaping the future of hospitality! If you’re ready to bring your talent, energy, and passion, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and let’s make every moment matter.

jobs.title: Director, Sales Support & Marketing
jobs.description:
We are looking for a commercially minded and proactive

**Director, Sales Support & Marketing for the** Xrock **Business Line**

As Director, Sales Support & Marketing, you will turn market and customer insights into initiatives that create measurable business impact and support our growth ambitions. You will support global sales areas in driving Xrock sales and own the Business Line's marketing strategy and execution, ensuring closer alignment between commercial activities in the field and the strategy, positioning, and tools that support them. As a member of the Business Line management team, you will work closely with sales areas, Business Line and product leaders, and supporting functions, reporting to the VP of the Xrock Business Line. The role is based in Lahti Finland, although other Normet locations can be considered if needed.

**Main responsibilities:**

**Sales support & global sales development**

- Drive global sales support in close cooperation with sales areas worldwide to strengthen Xrock sales performance.

- Design and deliver sales training that builds skills, tools, and materials for effective, consistent selling across sales areas.

- Take an active role in go-to-market planning together with sales areas and Business Line representatives.

- Develop and advance value-based and process-based selling across the organization, embedding a structured, repeatable sales approach.

- Work closely with all sales areas, tracking activities, and progress against strategic KPIs.


**Marketing strategy & stakeholder leadership**

- Develop the Xrock marketing strategy and KPIs together with the Business Line and global Normet stakeholders and lead their execution.

- Develop value propositions and sales-enablement materials, and plan integrated marketing communications that strengthen Xrock's brand and market presence.

- Manage relationships with external stakeholders, agencies, and partners.

- Analyze performance data and market feedback and apply modern AI-enabled tools to continuously improve results.


**To shine in this position, we hope you have:**

- Extensive experience in sales leadership, sales enablement, or B2B marketing, preferably in an international, technical, or solution-based business.

- A genuine drive to support sales areas and colleagues to succeed, and real satisfaction in seeing others achieve results.

- Proven leadership skills, with the ability to provide clear direction, foster collaboration and accountability within the team, and align priorities and resources to achieve business goals.

- Demonstrated ability to develop sales and marketing strategy and translate it into focused plans and hands-on execution.

- Strong business acumen and experience working closely with sales organizations to drive commercial growth.

- Proven experience in sales enablement, go-to-market or product launch activities, and integrated marketing campaigns; familiarity with value- and process-based selling is a plus.

- Willingness to travel globally and frequently to support sales areas and customers around the world.

- A proactive and highly collaborative working style, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders across functions, cultures, and organizational levels.


As an employer, we support your well-being with benefits such as ePassi lunch and Flex benefits for sports, wellness, and culture, occupational health care and specialist-level treatment through our work ability insurance, access to Aunties mental well-being services and more. We also support degree-oriented studies that benefit Normet with 10 paid working days per year.

jobs.title: Médecin militaire (m/f) (H/F)
jobs.description: Statut : Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? L'Armée luxembourgeoise est une force militaire moderne et professionnelle. Composée d'hommes et de femmes dévoués, elle a pour mission principale de défendre la souveraineté et l'intégrité du Grand-Duché, de contribuer à la sécurité nationale et internationale, et de participer aux opérations de maintien de la paix sous l'égide de l'OTAN, de l'Union européenne et des Nations Unies. Engagée dans un environnement multinational, l'Armée luxembourgeoise offre un cadre de travail où l'esprit d'équipe et le sens du devoir occupent une place centrale. Rejoindre l'Armée luxembourgeoise, c'est: Servir son pays dans un cadre porteur de valeurs fortes : droiture, engagement et fiabilité; Développer ses compétences à travers une formation continue et personnalisée; Évoluer dans une carrier/ière riche en opportunité et missions variées. Missions Le médecin militaire est le dernier maillon de la chaîne e sur le terrain des opérations, après le Combat Med et l'infirmier militaire; En mission, il est capable de prendre en charge des militaires blessés dans toutes les conditions; Sa formation lui permet d'appliquer ses compétences es dans un environnement militaire soumis à des contraintes tactiques et logistiques. Selon sa spécialisation, il peut exercer: En Role 1 : prise en charge visant à garantir la survie du patient dans des conditions dégradées, selon le principe du damage control resuscitation; En Role 2 : prise en charge incluant une capacité chirurgicale d'urgence, reposant sur le damage control surgery, privilégiant la rapidité et le contrôle des lésions vitales plutôt que leur réparation définitive immédiate; Pour entretenir ses compétences cliniques, le médecin militaire exerce également dans le domaine clinique civil. Profil Compétences techniques Être déployable pour toutes les missions et formations de l'Armée; Suivre les formations nécessaires; Maîtriser les outils bureautiques de base; Avoir de bonnes connaissances des opérations et missions de l'Armée luxembourgeoise; Avoir des connaissances de base en gestion des ressources humaines et logistiques. Compétences comportementales Faire preuve de sollicitude, de justice et d'impartialité; Donner l'exemple par la façon de se comporter et d'accomplir ses devoirs; Être ouvert aux relations interpersonnelles; Faire preuve de compétences de leadership; Faire preuve de professionnalisme; Adhérer aux valeurs-phares de l'Armée (engagement-droiture-fiabilité). Conditions d'admission Diplômes Vous êtes titulaire d'un grade ou diplôme délivré par un établissement d'enseignement supérieur reconnu par l'État du siège de l'établissement et sanctionnant l'accomplissement avec succès d'un master en Médecin spécialiste en traumatologie et médecine d'urgence ou de son équivalent. Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 7 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications. Vous disposez de l'autorisation d'exercer la profession. Langues Vous répondez aux exigences de connaissances des 3 langues administratives pour le groupe de traitement A1.  Vous avez la  luxembourgeoise. Être reconnu ement et psychologiquement apte pour le service militaire. Avoir une présentation compatible avec l'exercice de la fonction et le port d'uniforme.   Examen-concours: Examen-concours au Centre militaire du  au  octobre  Épreuve sportive, épreuves de langues, tests psychotechniques, épreuve de connaissances générales, évaluation psychologique et entretien de motivation. Incorporation janvier

jobs.title: DEEP - Cloud Systems Architect - Cloud Souverain (H/F)
jobs.description: Afin de renforcer les équipes de DEEP au sein de Business Line Cloud, nous recherchons actuellement un(e) DEEP - Cloud Systems Architect - Cloud Souverain (m/f/n) à temps plein.Vos missions Concevoir et spécifier des architectures cloud complexes sur OVH Public Cloud, Clever Cloud et, selon les besoins, OPCP, en garantissant leur performance, leur sécurité, leur résilience et leur conformité. Analyser les besoins métiers et techniques des clients, définir les trajectoires de transformation et élaborer les architectures et services cibles adaptées aux contraintes d'exploitation, de sécurité, de souveraineté et de time-to-market. Accompagner les projets de migration et de modernisation d'infrastructures et de plateformes applicatives vers OVH Public Cloud, Clever Cloud et des approches cloud native basées sur Kubernetes et services managés. Diriger ou encadrer l'intégration des composants techniques nécessaires aux solutions retenues : réseau, sécurité, IAM, observabilité, sauvegarde, CI/CD, registry, plateformes Kubernetes, services de données et composants d'automatisation. Garantir l'intégration de la sécurité dès la conception (security by design), ainsi que l'application des bonnes pratiques de résilience, de continuité, de sauvegarde, de conformité et de gouvernance. Piloter la standardisation et l'industrialisation des plateformes via l'Infrastructure as Code, l'automatisation, les pratiques DevOps/GitOps et les pipelines de déploiement. Définir et faire appliquer les architectures de référence pour les environnements cloud native, incluant les aspects de déploiement, d'observabilité, de logging, de gestion des secrets, de sécurité et de cycle de vie des plateformes. Apporter une expertise d'architecture sur les sujets PaaS, plateformes conteneurisées, intégration applicative, services managés et écosystèmes open source liés au cloud native. Jouer un rôle de référent technique auprès des équipes d'ingénierie, d'exploitation, de delivery, d'avant-vente et des clients, afin de sécuriser les choix techniques et de favoriser l'adoption des solutions définies. Assurer une veille technologique active et proposer des évolutions pertinentes sur les services OVH, Clever Cloud, les technologies cloud native et les approches d'automatisation afin d'enrichir les offres et les plateformes de DEEP. Réaliser des missions de consultance en architecture auprès des clients, afin de les accompagner dans la définition de leurs trajectoires cloud, l'évaluation des choix techniques et la conception de solutions adaptées à leurs enjeux métier et techniques. Supporter, concevoir et faire émerger de nouveaux services autour de ses domaines de compétence (cloud public, cloud native, architecture, automatisation, plateforme), en participant à la définition des standards, des briques techniques, de la documentation et du positionnement de ces services dans le catalogue de l'entreprise. Votre profil Disposer d'une formation de niveau Master spécialisée en informatique, systèmes, réseaux et cloud, et/ou d'une expérience professionnelle équivalente. Disposer d'une expérience significative dans la conception, l'intégration ou l'évolution d'architectures cloud pour des clients, avec une capacité démontrée à cadrer des solutions complexes. Maîtriser les concepts et architectures IaaS, PaaS, KaaS, cloud public, cloud souverain et services managés. Avoir une connaissance d'OVH Public Cloud et/ou de Clever Cloud. Maîtriser les principes d'architecture cloud native et les plateformes conteneurisées, en particulier Kubernetes et l'écosystème associé. Connaître plusieurs technologies cloud native et DevOps parmi les suivant/antes : GitLab, Keycloak, Nexus, SonarQube, FluxCD, Crossplane, Velero, Kasten, RabbitMQ, Kafka, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, AKS, EKS ou équivalents. Avoir une bonne connaissance dans les pratiques d'automatisation et d'Infrastructure as Code telles que Terraform, Ansible ou équivalents, ainsi que les approches CI/CD et GitOps. Être capable d'intégrer les exigences de sécurité, de conformité, de gouvernance et d'exploitabilité dans les choix d'architecture. Disposer de solides compétences rédactionnelles pour formaliser les architectures, les dossiers techniques et les standards de mise en œuvre. Intéressé(e) ?
