jobs.title: Lärare inom småbarnspedagogik sökes till vårt tvåspråkiga daghem på Drumsö
jobs.description:
**Är du lärare inom småbarnspedagogik och redo för nya utmaningar?**

Vill du vara med och skapa en trygg, inspirerande och glädjefylld vardag för våra yngsta barn? Tycker du om att upptäcka världen tillsammans med nyfikna 1–3-åringar och ser styrkan i tvåspråkighet, lek och närvaro?

Då kanske du är den vi söker!

På **Daghemmet Ankdammen på Drumsö** får du arbeta i en varm och engagerad arbetsgemenskap där barnens välmående, pedagogik av hög kvalitet och ett nära samarbete med familjerna står i centrum. Vi erbjuder dig möjligheten att utvecklas i din yrkesroll och vara en viktig del av barnens första år inom småbarnspedagogiken.

**Vi erbjuder dig:**

- Fast anställning

- Små barngrupper

- Trivsamma och högklassiga lokaler

- Stöd från ett engagerat och kunnigt team

- Möjlighet att arbeta i en inspirerande tvåspråkig verksamhet

- En arbetsplats där både barn och vuxna får växa


**Om oss**

Päiväkoti Ankkalampi – Daghemmet Ankdammen är en privat tvåspråkig aktör inom småbarnspedagogik som erbjuder en trygg, lekfull och pedagogiskt genomtänkt vardag för barn och familjer.

Läs mer om oss på **www.ankkalampi.fi**

Väckte annonsen ditt intresse? Skicka din ansökan eller ett fritt formulerat e-postmeddelande till:

**rekry@ankkalampi-ankdammen.fi**

Märk ansökan med **"BS Drumsö"**. Vi behandlar ansökningar löpande och ser fram emot att höra från dig!

**Hoppas vi ses på Ankdammen på Drumsö!**

jobs.title: Sygeplejerske til Operation og Opvågning  Dagkirurgi 4, Bedøvelse og Operation Syd, Aarhus Universitetshospital (genopslag)
jobs.description:
Drømmer at være en del af et dynamisk, fagligt stærkt og velfungerende dagkirurgisk afsnit? med fri i weekender og på helligdage?

Så er her en mulighed for at: 

få en hverdag med mening, udvikling og fantastiske kollega fællesskab.

Vi øger vores aktivitet og opnormerer. Vi søger derfor en frisk og dedikeret sygeplejerske, som har lyst at være med til at udvikle fremtidens dagkirurgi. Hvor vi sammen skal sikre den sygeplejefaglige kvalitet i et sundhedsvæsen i forandring, i en tid hvor flere og flere patientforløb overgår til dag- og sammedagskirurgi. 

Hos os får du en unik mulighed for at arbejde med hele patientforløbet i et speciale i udvikling. Du bliver en del af et fagligt stærkt afsnit, hvor kvalitet, udvikling og arbejdsglæde går hånd i hånd, og hvor vi prioriterer både patientoplevelsen og medarbejdertrivslen højt.

Vi har et stærkt læringsmiljø med undervisning, simulation og faglig sparring som en naturlig del af hverdagen.

 

En hverdag med helhedssygepleje

I Dagkirurgi 4 arbejder vi med korttidssygepleje og følger patienten gennem hele forløbet:

Modtagelse → Operation → Opvågning → Udskrivelse

Den helhedsorienterede tilgang giver et varieret arbejde med stor selvstændighed og tæt patientkontakt. Samtidig bidrager den til høj sygeplejefaglig kvalitet og sammenhængende patientforløb.

Vi har fokus på at skabe trygge, individuelle og sammenhængende patientforløb Og arbejder med Fundamentals of Care (FoC)

 

Spændende specialer og nye muligheder

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med patienter inden for:

  • Kvindesygdomme
  • Nedre mave- og tarmsygdomme
  • Urinvejskirurgi
  • Plastik og brystkirurgi 

 

Vi tilbyder
  • et spændende og varieret arbejde i et dagkirurgisk afsnit i udvikling
  • et struktureret introduktionsforløb tilpasset dine kompetencer og erfaringer
  • en engageret personalegruppe med humor, hjælpsomhed og stærkt kollegialt sammenhold
  • et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde med fokus på kvalitet og patientoplevelser
  • ønskeplan med indflydelse på egen arbejdstilrettelæggelse - fri i weekender og på helligdage
  • fast undervisning hver onsdag morgen (mono- og tværfaglig undervisning)

- Månedlig simulationstræning med fokus på kliniske færdigheder, akutte situationer,

   kommunikation og tværfagligt samarbejde

  • Sociale aktiviteter og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab, fx i biografklub, efter arbejde 
  • Mulighed for ansættelse på 32-37 timer ugentligt.

 

Vi søger en sygeplejerske, der
  • har teknisk flair og interesse for instrumentel sygepleje og digitale løsninger
  • har lyst til at påvirke sygeplejens udvikling i et dagkirurgisk afsnit
  • trives med højt patientflow og kan bevare overblikket
  • har stærke kompetencer i planlægning, prioritering og koordinering
  • er positiv, refleksiv og løsningsorienteret
  • rr omstillingsparat og trives i en hverdag i bevægelse og konstant forandring
  • har interesse for at planlægge og implementere IT-løsninger, der styrker kvalitet og patientforløb
  • har gode kommunikations- og samarbejdsevner
  • vil bidrage aktivt til et stærkt og udviklende tværfagligt arbejdsmiljø.

Erfaring fra operation, opvågning eller dagkirurgi er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

 

Hvem er vi?

Vi er et afsnit med høje faglige ambitioner og et stærkt fokus på kvalitet, læring og sammenhængende patientforløb.

Vi prioriterer kompetenceudvikling højt og arbejder systematisk med læring i praksis. Undervisning, faglig sparring og simulation er en integreret del af vores hverdag.

En gang om måneden gennemfører vi simulationstræning, hvor vi træner kliniske scenarier og styrker samarbejdet på tværs af faggrupper. Det bidrager til høj patientsikkerhed, faglig udvikling og tryghed i mødet med både kendte og uforudsete situationer.

Afsnittet er uddannelsessted for medicinstuderende, sygeplejestuderende, paramedicinere og anæstesikursister, og vi ser uddannelse og videndeling som en vigtig del af vores kultur.

Hos os møder du engagerede kolleger med forskellige erfaringer og kompetencer, som alle bidrager til et stærkt fællesskab og en arbejdsplads, hvor vi hjælper hinanden.

 

Arbejdstid og ansættelsesvilkår
  • Afsnittet har åbent på hverdage kl. 07.30-17.00
  • Vagter primært kl. 07.30-15.30 med enkelte vagter til kl. 17.00
  • Ansættelse på 32-37 timer ugentligt efter aftale
  • Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst
  • Ansættelsen er betinget af gyldig autorisation
  • Der indhentes børneattest.

 

Kom og besøg os

Vil du opleve stemningen og se, om Dagkirurgi 4 er det rette sted for dig?

Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte os eller komme forbi til en uformel snak og rundvisning.

Kontakt:
oversygeplejerske Sandra Zacho Tingskov
2421 9156
sating@rm.dk

 

Ansøgning, Vi prøver med en hurtig frist med ønske om hurtig tiltrædelse, har vi ikke de rette ansøgere her forlænger vi fristen.

Ansøgningsfrist: den 20. september 2026.
Samtaler: den 22. eller 23. september 2026. 
Tiltrædelse: den 1. november 2026 eller efter aftale.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig

 

 


Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

jobs.title: Postdoc in sodium-ion battery state estimation
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a position as Postdoc in sodium-ion battery state estimation is open for appointment from 1st of November 2026 or as soon as possible hereafter. The position is available for a period of 20 months and is based at Aalborg University’s campus in Aalborg.

You will be part of the research group Batteries, which is placed in the section for Mechatronic Systems. The position is closely connected to our activities within applied battery research, and your work will contribute to the development of new knowledge within this field.

Your work tasks
In this position you will conduct research within battery state estimation, with a particular focus on emerging sodium-ion battery technology. You will be involved in both independent and collaborative research activities in close interaction with colleagues in the group and external partners in Denmark and abroad.

You will work with the design and execution of research studies, the analysis and interpretation of data, and the dissemination of results in high-quality scientific outlets. Your daily work will typically involve a combination of independent research and collaboration in project teams, where you help develop concepts, methods and solutions that are relevant for the energy sector.

In particular, you will be involved in a research project related to development of a battery management system (BMS) tailored for sodium-ion batteries. The tasks include battery cell characterization and modelling based on laboratory tests, and development of algorithms for estimating the charge level, health, and power capability which includes robustness against different operation conditions. The position is a part of a research project and prototype battery modules will be produced by one of the partners. The tasks include testing of these prototype modules as well. Sodium-ion batteries is a relatively new technology, and they have their own electrochemical properties. One of the key questions of this research project is to obtain a better understanding of the difference between emerging sodium-ion batteries and traditional lithium-ion based batteries when it comes to the battery state estimation and management.

You will be expected to contribute to scientific publications in international peer-reviewed journals and to present your work at conferences, workshops and meetings with partners. You will collaborate with researchers across the department and, where relevant, with industrial or public stakeholders. The position may include a limited amount of teaching and supervision of students at bachelor’s and master’s level, for example in the form of project supervision or involvement in courses related to your expertise. Depending on project needs, you may also take part in preparing applications for external research funding and in supporting the development of new research directions at the department.

Your competencies
You hold a PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Engineering, Electrochemistry or a closely related field or can document equivalent scientific qualifications at PhD level. Your research profile is clearly connected to battery state estimation, and you can demonstrate experience with development of battery electric equivalent circuit models and algorithms for estimating the charge, health, and power based on direct methods (e.g. open circuit voltage), model-based methods (e.g. Kalman filtering), data driven methods (e.g. machine learning or neural networks), etc. The experience could come from lithium-ion, lithium-ion capacitor, sodium-ion, or other battery technologies.

You have solid skills in Matlab/Simulink simulation tool, experimental work in laboratory environments, working with battery cyclers and equipment for electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS), preparing battery test setups, and data processing and analysis of battery test data and you are comfortable working systematically with complex technical problems. Experience with industrial collaboration and battery management systems will be an advantage, as well as documented ability to publish in international journals.

You communicate clearly in English, both orally and in writing, and you can present your work to both specialists and non-specialists. If you already speak Danish or would like to learn it, this will be an asset in everyday life at the university and in Danish society, and language courses are available locally.

You are motivated by working in an international academic environment, where you collaborate closely with colleagues, share knowledge and contribute actively to joint projects, while also managing your own tasks in a structured and responsible way. You are curious, open to feedback and able to move projects forward from idea to concrete results within agreed deadlines.

Who we are
AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

Do you have any questions?
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us.

For professional questions, please contact Erik Schaltz, Associate Professor, esc@energy.aau.dk, +45 99403302.

Qualification requirements
Appointment as postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma)
  • List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications.
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications if relevant.
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc.
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position
  • References/recommendations

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Further information
Read more about our recruitment process here

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Salary and terms of employment
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities (the Appointment Order) and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities (in Danish) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities (in Danish).

Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) (only in Danish) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities (only in Danish).

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Työt alkavat heti sopivan avustajan löydyttyä.

jobs.title: Postdoc in Thermal Processes in Power to X Technologies
jobs.description:

You will be part of the research group Hydrogen and Electrofuels, which is placed in the section for E specialised in Thermal Engineering. In this position you will conduct research within CFD modelling, with a particular focus on the projects MetNH3Energy and ACE Water. In particular, you will be involved in the project MetNH3Energy, in the topic of Hydrogen storage and Transport using Ammonia and modelling in CFD on ammonia leakage and the project ACE Water, in the topic degradation in LTEL and HTEL stacks and developing lifetime models, life-time predictions and the validation of them.

Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

Qualification requirements 
Appointment as postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level. 

How to apply  
Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications. 
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications if relevant.
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society. 

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment. 

Do you have any questions? 
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

Further information 
Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities (the Appointment Order) and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities (in Danish) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities (in Danish). 

Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) (only in Danish) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities (only in Danish). 

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Odotamme sinulta:
Myyjän työssä tarvitaan positiivista asiakaspalveluasennetta, hyvät sosiaaliset taidot ja reipasta oma-aloitteisuutta. Etsimme toimeen tarttuvaa tyyppiä, joka ei pelkää ryhtyä töihin ja saa hommat hoidettua. Myyjän työ on tänä päivänä yhä digitaalisempaa, ja siksi odotamme sinulta myös sujuvaa otetta järjestelmiin ja myymälän teknisiin työvälineisiin. Aikaisempi kokemus kaupanalan tehtävistä on plussaa, mutta positiivinen asenne ja aito halu tehdä asiakaspalvelutyötä ovat tehtävässä menestyäksesi kaikkein tärkeintä. Me Eepeellä sanomme olevamme Ihan tavallisissatöissä. Työtä kuvaillaan usein erilaisin korulausein, jotka toivottavasti ovat myös totta, mutta meidän mielestämme ihan tavallinen työ on mahtavaa. jobs.title: Doctoral Researcher / Research Assistant in Law in the Academy Project JustISA
jobs.description:
Faculty of Law University of Lapland is hiring a doctoral researcher in law in the JustISA Academy project. The position is full-time during the period 1.1.2027 - 31.8.2029, located in Rovaniemi.

The project is carried out at the Faculty of Law in collaboration with the Department of Social Sciences within the Faculty of Human and Social Sciences at Åbo Akademi. Both research environments have a strong tradition of research on vulnerabilities and human rights, which is central to this project.

The project JustISA Surrogacy Agreements and Interdisciplinary Pathways to Minimum Justice: A Comparative Study of Finland, Colombia and Greece is an interdisciplinary collaboration between law and sociology. The project investigates international surrogacy arrangements and justice-related issues such as the childs best interests, the desire for parenthood, legislative circumvention, as well as risks and consequences for the individuals involved and for the legal systems through analysis of surrogacy agreements from Colombia and Greece, interviews, social media and other texts from online sources. The doctoral researchers thesis will primarily be based on surrogacy contracts and related expert interviews. The project group and the supervision team include experts in reproduction and parenthood, rights issues, law and the data mining method.

Work tasks

We offer you a social and independent job on an international and interdisciplinary project in a dynamic and pleasant work environment. The tasks of the doctoral researcher include:

- Contribute to project planning and project administration, for example in relation to project meetings

- Plan and implement data collection in relation to expert interviews and analyze surrogacy contracts in accordance with the project plan

- Write the scientific articles of the dissertation in collaboration with supervisors and researchers in the project

- Conduct a research visit abroad

- Completing doctoral studies and writing the thesis comprehensive summary

- Present research results at project meetings and national and international conferences

- Participate in other duties related to the role assigned by the employer. Tasks in teaching may occur to a small extent.

Competence

We are looking for you who have a masters degree, or who is finalising masters degree, in law, preferably masters studies in family law, contract law or law and welfare. Previous studies related to reproduction and/or experience with socio-legal research methods are considered meritorious. Previous experience of academic publishing is also considered a merit. It may also be possible to appoint a candidate who is currently completing their master's degree and who could start working as a research assistant if they are not yet eligible to apply for doctoral studies at the Faculty of Law during the autumn application period (15-29 September 2026).

We assume that you have very good knowledge of English. Knowledge of Finnish, Swedish, Greek or Spanish is an advantage. You also have good communication and collaboration skills as well as the ability to work independently and in a structured way.

We offer

- interesting work tasks as part of an international university community

- modern work equipment and facilities

- a stable organisation to work in

- opportunities for professional development

- extensive occupational health services

- sport, culture and wellbeing benefits.

Application

Submit your application via the Universitys electronic application form below. Attach the cover letter and CV with a list of publications as well as brief research plan (2-3 pages) regarding your JustISA related research interests and PhD project. The documents can be either in Finnish or English. Provide the contact details of reference persons that the employer can contact if necessary.

Information

For further information on the position, please contact Katja Karjalainen, Principal Investigator, phone number +358 40 187 1964, e-mail katja.karjalainen@ulapland.fi

In order to be employed as a doctoral researcher, the person who is employed must be enrolled as a doctoral researcher at University of Lapland no later than in connection with the start of the employment. Information about the application process for admission for a doctoral study right can be found here: [Apply for doctoral programmes - University of Lapland](https://ulapland.fi/en/study-with-us/apply-for-doctoral-programmes/)

It may also be possible to appoint a candidate who is currently completing their master's degree and who could start working as a research assistant if they are not yet eligible to apply for doctoral studies at the Faculty of Law during the autumn application period (15-29 September 2026).


Workplace address: Yliopistonkatu 8, 96300 ROVANIEMI
Duration of employment: 1.1.2027 - 31.8.2029
Work hours: full-time employment
Trial period: 6 months
Salary: The universitys salary system is based on the requirements of the task and personal performance. The position of research assistant adheres to requirement level 1 of the university salary system for teaching and research staff. The position of doctoral researcher adheres to requirement levels 2-3 of the university salary system for teaching and research staff. The starting salary of a research assistant is 2120,11 €. The starting salary of a doctoral researcher is 2331,67 - 2561,23 €. In addition, a personal performance-based salary component is paid, amounting up to 50% of the task-specific salary component.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor in Thermal Engineering with a Focus on Electronics Cooling in Early Component Design
jobs.description:
Fixed-term full-time position (4 years), to be filled from 1 November 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter, at the Aalborg campus.

If you want to contribute to the next generation of high-power electronic components by integrating thermal design directly into the early stages of technology and component development, this position may be the right opportunity for you. We are looking for an Assistant Professor for the Section for Thermal Engineering who can strengthen and further develop our activities within electronics cooling, thermal-fluid modelling, and the integration of thermal design considerations into the early development of future technologies. The position includes research, teaching, and collaboration with both internal and external partners, and you will play an active role in shaping new projects together with colleagues in power electronics. Over time, you are expected to contribute actively to joint research projects and external funding applications that bridge thermal engineering and power electronics in the design of future power modules.

Your work tasks
As an Assistant Professor in the Section for Thermal Engineering, you will join a strong academic environment where research, teaching, and collaboration with external partners are closely linked. The position is based at the Aalborg campus, and you will be part of an international department working within thermal energy systems, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and related areas. In this position, you will work in close collaboration with researchers in power electronics, in particular Associate Professor Stig Munk Nielsen and colleagues in the power electronics and devices environment. Together, you will contribute to the co-design of new power modules where thermal, electrical, and mechanical aspects are considered on equal footing from the earliest design stages.

Your primary research task will be to develop and carry out research in electronics cooling and thermal-fluid design methods, with a particular focus on supporting decision-making in the early stages of technology and component development. This includes thermal-fluid co-design of devices such as IGBTs, MOSFETs, power modules, and other switching devices, where cooling concepts are integrated as explicit design parameters alongside electrical and electromagnetic performance. You will analyse trade-offs between thermal resistance, temperature gradients, power density, lifetime, and reliability, and contribute to the development of thermal and fluid-dynamic models that can be used early in the development process for screening and optimisation before detailed designs are fixed.

Depending on your background, you may initially focus more strongly on modelling, experiments, or design methodology, and gradually expand your activities towards broader thermal-fluid co-design research.

A central part of your work will be to explore and assess advanced cooling concepts for high-power-density systems. This may include integrated cooling solutions, direct-liquid cooling, and two-phase cooling for very high heat fluxes. You will develop and use Computational Fluid Dynamics models in combination with analytical and reduced-order models, and contribute to publishing research results in international journals and conferences. Over time, you are expected to contribute actively to the development of joint research activities and external funding applications together with colleagues from thermal engineering and power electronics.

In parallel with the modelling activities, you will contribute to experimental work at component and module level. This can include development and use of experimental setups for characterisation of thermal resistances and heat fluxes, and validation of cooling concepts at chip, module, and package level. You will work with the interplay between experiments, CFD, and reduced-order models to develop design tools that are sufficiently fast for iterative early-stage development while still capturing the relevant physics.

In teaching, you will contribute to bachelor’s and master’s level courses within thermal engineering, including fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and thermal systems. You will help develop exercises and project activities that draw on realistic engineering problems and demonstrate the interaction between electrical loading, losses, and cooling solutions. You will supervise project and thesis students working on thermal design, cooling concepts, modelling, and experimental investigations. Over time, you are expected to develop a coherent teaching profile linked closely to your research activities and collaborations.

In addition, you will contribute to shared tasks within the section and department, including industry collaboration, study programme development, and supervision of projects associated with externally funded activities.

Your competencies
You have a solid academic background within Energy Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or a closely related field, and you hold a PhD degree that qualifies you to work independently with research and research-based teaching.

We recognise that strong candidates may not fulfil every aspect of the profile. Applicants with a strong background in thermal engineering, thermal-fluid modelling, simulation-driven design, or technology development are encouraged to apply, provided they are motivated to further develop competences in electronics cooling and interdisciplinary research.

It is essential that you can document strong competences in flow simulations and thermal modelling, including model development. You have experience using Computational Fluid Dynamics and thermal models as tools to support design and development decisions, rather than solely as post-design analysis tools. You are comfortable working with software environments such as Ansys and OpenFOAM and are motivated to further develop and apply these tools in the context of advanced thermal systems and electronic components.

Prior experience within electronics cooling, component design, thermal management, or related technology development activities will be considered an advantage, but applicants from adjacent fields with strong thermal-fluid competences are also encouraged to apply. Experience from research and development activities, either in academia or industry, including participation in technology development projects and collaboration across disciplines, will likewise be considered an advantage.

Experience with experimental methods in thermal and fluid mechanics, including data analysis, uncertainty estimation, and model validation, is desirable. Familiarity with optical measurement techniques in fluid mechanics and heat transfer will be particularly relevant, as you may contribute to laboratory teaching and research activities.

You are able to reason across scales, from components to systems, and you understand when models must be highly detailed and when lightweight approaches are needed to support efficient development processes.

You communicate clearly in English, both in writing and orally, and are willing to engage with students, colleagues, and external partners in an international environment. Since part of the teaching and industrial collaboration takes place in Danish, you are expected to be able to supervise students in Danish within two years of employment.

As a colleague, you are motivated by interdisciplinary collaboration and enjoy working at the interface between different engineering disciplines, where modelling, experiments, and design considerations must be integrated to develop effective solutions. You bring strong analytical skills, an interest in both modelling and experiments, and a collaborative mindset. You take ownership of your work, follow through on commitments, and contribute positively to the academic environment.

Who we are
AAU Energy is an research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners, utilities and other academic environments to address real world energy challenges. 

Aalborg University has been ranked as the best university in Europe within energy research and is among the very best universities worldwide in this field. At AAU Energy you will be part of a top international environment where research, innovation and collaboration are used to develop solutions to global challenges such as the green transition and future energy systems. 

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and with diverse national and disciplinary backgrounds, which creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as working language in both research and teaching, which supports the integration of international colleagues. 

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.  

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support  

Qualification requirements 
Appointment as assistant professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level. The research potential of each applicant will be emphasized in the overall assessment.

How to apply  
Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications.
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications. Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design, The Faculty of Engineering and Science and The Faculty of Medicine. 
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society. 

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment. 

Do you have any questions? 
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

 Further information 
Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities (the Appointment Order) and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities (in Danish) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities (in Danish). 

Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) (only in Danish) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities (only in Danish). 

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.title: Research Assistant / Forskningsassistent (Academy of Finland-project REALS)
jobs.description:
About the job

This is a tight call for a Ukrainian-speaking RESEARCH ASSISTANT to be employed for project REALS – Relational Ethics and Affective/Lived Security: Care, Resilience and Embodiment in Times of Crisis and Hanken School of Economics.

Hanken School of Economics is a leading, internationally accredited business school, recognized for its international orientation and outstanding research quality in proportion to its size. We have close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 16 000 alumni. We are located in Helsinki and Vaasa, Finland.

Project

Project REALS explores how security is organised when formal systems are under strain, such as in times of war, disaster, or large-scale societal disruption. Bringing together perspectives from organisation studies, ethics of care, and arts-based research, the project extends understandings of security as purely institutional or technical. A central focus is how care, trust, and shared responsibility emerge in everyday practices when communities respond to crisis situations. The research draws on fieldwork conducted in Ukraine, including observations and interviews with emergency responders, humanitarian actors, and members of civil society.

Work

The tasks can be, but are not limited to:

- transcribing and translating interviews
- data search online (YouTube interviews, public media articles, reports, and other publicly available sources)
- participant recruitment and fieldwork activities, including identifying potential interviewees, assisting with interview scheduling and coordination, and, where appropriate, conducting interviews.
- assisting in the planning and organization of research dissemination and stakeholder engagement activities, such as seminars, workshops, and other communication events.

Employment: part-time employment (80 %), 1.10.2026-31.12.2026 (with a possibility of extension).

Job requirements

- good proficiency of English and Ukrainian, both spoken and written.
- good personal skills and ability to work as a member of a team.

- Please note that the research project engages with sensitive topics and contexts. Candidates should therefore be prepared to work with potentially challenging material and demonstrate an awareness of: emotional self-management and well-being, self-care practices when engaging with sensitive research data, ethical and secure data management. Training, guidance, and relevant support resources will be provided throughout the project.
- Familiarity with, and genuine interest in, the research context and subject matter will be considered a strong asset.

Documentation to be attached:

- CV
- Cover letter
- Language certificates if the skill level is not apparent in other attached documents
- Additional attachments, e.g. degree certificates, work experience and other merits that the applicant wishes to be considered

The salary is based on the university salary system in Finland (including employee healthcare, pension, and holiday contributions) and placed on job requirement level 4-6 for administrative staff, with an additional personal performance-based salary element.

For more details of the position, please contact the project PI, Anna Dziuba, anna.dziuba@hanken.fi.

Applications including the CV and other relevant documentation should be submitted in Hanken recruitment database LAURA no later than 06.09.2026.

___________________________________________________________

Forskningsassistent (ukrainsktalande) till projektet Finlands Akademi-projektet REALS vid Hanken Svenska handelshögskolan

Om positionen

Vi söker en ukrainsktalande forskningsassistent som ska anställas inom projektet REALS – Relational Ethics and Affective/Lived Security: Care, Resilience and Embodiment in Times of Crisis vid Hanken Svenska handelshögskolan.

Hanken är en ledande, internationellt ackrediterad handelshögskola som är erkänd för sin internationella profil och höga forskningskvalitet i förhållande till sin storlek. Vi har nära samarbete med näringslivet och ett aktivt alumnnätverk med över 16 000 alumner. Hanken finns i Helsingfors och Vasa.

Projektet

Projektet REALS undersöker hur trygghet och säkerhet organiseras när formella system utsätts för påfrestningar, exempelvis under krig, katastrofer eller omfattande samhälleliga störningar. Genom att förena perspektiv från organisationsforskning, omsorgsetik och konstbaserad forskning utvecklar projektet förståelsen av säkerhet bortom rent institutionella eller tekniska perspektiv.

Ett centralt fokus är hur omsorg, tillit och delat ansvar växer fram i vardagliga praktiker när samhällen och lokalsamhällen hanterar krissituationer. Forskningen bygger på fältarbete i Ukraina, inklusive observationer och intervjuer med räddningspersonal, humanitära aktörer och representanter för civilsamhället.

Arbetsuppgifter

Arbetsuppgifterna kan inkludera, men är inte begränsade till:

- transkribering och översättning av intervjuer
- informationssökning på internet (YouTube-intervjuer, offentliga medieartiklar, rapporter och andra offentligt tillgängliga källor)
- rekrytering av deltagare och fältarbetsaktiviteter, inklusive identifiering av potentiella intervjupersoner, stöd vid tidsbokning och koordinering av intervjuer samt, när det är lämpligt, genomförande av intervjuer
- medverkan i planering och organisering av forskningsspridning och aktiviteter för intressentdialog, såsom seminarier, workshoppar och andra kommunikations-arrangemang

Anställning: Deltidsanställning (80 %) 1.10.2026–31.12.2026 (med möjlighet till förlängning)

Kvalifikationskrav

- goda kunskaper i engelska och ukrainska, både muntligt och skriftligt
- god samarbetsförmåga och förmåga att arbeta som en del av ett team
- Observera att forskningsprojektet behandlar känsliga ämnen och sammanhang. Kandidater bör därför vara beredda att arbeta med potentiellt krävande material och visa medvetenhet om: emotionell självhantering och välbefinnande, egenomsorg vid arbete med känsligt forskningsmaterial, etisk och säker hantering av forskningsdata. Utbildning, handledning och relevanta stödtjänster erbjuds under hela projektets gång.
- Erfarenhet av och ett genuint intresse för forskningskontexten och ämnesområdet ses som en betydande merit.

Bilagor som ska bifogas ansökan

- CV

As a Power System Analyst, you will:
* Actively engage in and provide robust support for our global market development and decarbonization service activities, utilizing power system modelling tools such as Plexos – power system optimization software, Python and Excel-based tools. Leverage these tools to analyse opportunities and quantify system-level benefits.
* Conduct comprehensive energy market and country analyses to underpin project and market development initiatives, offering valuable insights and strategic guidance.
* Collaborate in supporting Wärtsilä strategy by contributing to the development of compelling value propositions, conducting feasibility analyses, and creating sophisticated analysis tools.
* Perform techno-commercial analyses for projects, playing a key role in supporting the sales organization and ensuring a thorough understanding of the market landscape.
* Effectively communicate and present analysis results to both internal and external stakeholders of Wärtsilä. This includes active participation in meetings, seminars, and other influential events where insights can drive informed decision-making.
* Take ownership of developing and maintaining power system models and feasibility calculation tools, ensuring their accuracy and relevance in the ever-evolving energy landscape.
* Contribute to the advancement of process-based system modelling, with a focus on data storage and handling, as well as result analytics and visualization. Stay at the forefront of developments in this field to continually enhance our modelling capabilities.


To be successful in this role, certain qualifications should align with your profile:
* Recently graduated from university or nearing graduation, with a major in economics, finance, operations research, computer science, or other quantitatively focused disciplines and a general understanding of modern electric power systems.
* Alignment with our core values – Customer Success, Passion, and Performance – should resonate with you, and you naturally embody these values in your daily work, demonstrating ownership and responsibility.
* Possess excellent analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset, showcasing an ability to model and resolve complex issues.
* While knowledge of Python, Plexos or power system modelling software is advantageous, prior experience is not mandatory.
* Possess a basic understanding of data analytics and coding.
* Being a team player with strong interpersonal skills is crucial, along with a genuine interest in the energy business and enthusiasm for travel.
* Fluency in English. Other language skills are considered a plus.


Why you and us?
You are valued – as your true self. At Wärtsilä YOU matter. We value diversity and are committed in supporting inclusive work community.
Your growth is supported. We believe in continuous learning & teamwork. Wärtsilian community has your back when it comes to development opportunities – so you can develop beyond your potential.
You get to make a difference. Innovation and sustainability are important for us. Every day, we - Wärtsilians - put our hearts and minds into enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services into reality.

Contact & next steps
Please submit your application before the application deadline of 11 September 2026 through our Careers portal. Applications through email will not be considered. After submitting your application, you will receive a confirmation email.

In case of any questions regarding the position, reach out to:

Michael Ball
Director, Business Development, Wärtsilä Energy
michael.ball@wartsila.com

jobs.title: Keikkatekijää keittiöön Kristiinankaupunkiin
jobs.description:
Etsimme Kristiinankaupungille keikkatekijöitä keittiön eri tehtäviin. Olipa taustasi sitten suurtalouskokki tai astiahuoltaja, niin etsimme eri pituisiin sijaisuuksiin reippaita ja motivoituneita tekijöitä.

Kristiinankaupungin alueella sekä lähikunnissa on kouluja sekä päiväkoteja, joiden keittiöihin tarvitaan silloin tällöin sijaisia. Onko sinulla tarvetta keikkatyölle tai haluatko saada "jalkaa oven väliin"? Tässä on sinulle oiva mahdollisuus päästä tutustumaan eri toimipisteiden tehtäviin.

Etsimme osaavia ja koulutuksen omaavia kokkeja sekä keittiöapulaisia avustaviin tehtäviin.
- Kokin tehtävään vaadimme koulutuksen tai vähintään työkokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä sekä kielitaitoa (suomi tai ruotsi).
- Keittiöapulaiseksi etsimme reippaita, motivoituneita tekijöitä, jotka omaa kokemusta keittiö ympäristön eri töistä. Kielitaitona mieluiten suomi tai ruotsi, mutta myös hyvä englanti riittää.
Mitä me etsimme:
- Tarvetta on erityisesti keikka-tekijöille, joten arvostamme mahdollisuutta vastaanottaa työvuoroja lyhyelläkin varoitusajalla. Toki samoja sijaisia kysytään aina ensisijaisesti myös pidempiin sijaisuuksiin.
- Työvuorot ovat aina arkisin 7-17 välisenä aikana.
- Oman auton käyttöä, sillä sijaisuuksia voi tulla myös lähiseudulta
- Hygieniapassin tulee olla voimassa

Noudatamme työssä KVTES palkkataulukkoa:
Keittäjän (tasopalkka 4RUO50B1) tuntipalkka 15,25€
Keittäjän (tasopalkka 4RUO50A1) tuntipalkka 13,95€
Keittiöapulaisen tuntipalkka (tasopalkka 4RUO70A1) 13,32€

På Svenska:
Vi söker till Kristinestad inhoppare till olika köksuppgifter. Oavsett om du har bakgrund som storkock eller diskare söker vi pigga och motiverade personer för vikariat av olika längd.
I Kristinestads område samt i närliggande kommuner finns skolor och daghem vars kök periodvis är i behov av vikarier. Har du behov av inhopp eller vill du få in en fot genom dörren? Här har du en utmärkt möjlighet att bekanta dig med arbetsuppgifter vid olika enheter.

Vi söker yrkeskunniga och utbildade kockar samt köksbiträden för assisterande uppgifter.
- För kockuppgifter kräver vi utbildning eller minst arbetserfarenhet från motsvarande uppgifter samt språkkunskaper (finska eller svenska).
- Som köksbiträde söker vi pigga och motiverade personer, som har erfarenhet av olika arbetsuppgifter i köksmiljö. Språkkunskaper i första hand finska eller svenska, men även god engelska räcker.

Vad vi söker:
- Behovet gäller i synnerhet inhoppare, så vi uppskattar möjlighet att ta emot arbetspass även med kort varsel. Samma vikarier tillfrågas i första hand också för längre vikariat.
- Arbetspassen är alltid vardagar mellan kl. 7–17.
- Tillgång till egen bil, eftersom vikariat även kan förekomma i närområdet.
- Giltigt hygienpass krävs.
Vi erbjuder en bra introduktion!

Vi följer KVTES lönetabell:
- Kock (grundlön 4RUO50B1): timlön 15,25 €
- Kock (grundlön 4RUO50A1): timlön 13,95 €
- Köksbiträde (grundlön 4RUO70A1): timlön 13,32 €

jobs.title: Assistant, Tenure-Track Assistant, and Associate Professorships in Software Engineering and Software Technology
jobs.description:
SDU Centre for Software Technology in Vejle, part of the Software Engineering units at SDU situated at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invite applications for one or more positions within software engineering and software technology. The positions are open from beginning of 2027, and the specific start date will be agreed with the successful candidates. 

The application deadline is September 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

What we offer

With a position at SDU, you will:

  • be part of one of our dynamic research centres with both a national and international profile, while working in areas of tremendous potential and societal relevance;

  • join collaborations across the university, as well as with national, international, and industrial research partners;

  • help establish joint innovation projects in close collaboration with industry and the local society;

  • help build up the research and educational environment;

  • contribute to the teaching programmes in Software Engineering at the highest level for undergraduate and graduate students at SDU;

  • join a harmonious workplace environment that is conducive to productivity, promotes creativity, and rewards and recognizes individuals and group achievement;

  • have the opportunity to live and work in one of the happiest countries in the world that also offers excellent and free health and education systems.

 

What we expect

The focus of the SDU Centre for Software Technology is research and education in software engineering, interactive technology and artificial intelligence. We see these areas complementing each other to make way for the engineering of the next generation of reliable, intelligent and interactive software solutions. We are particularly interested in software operated in real life, systems that adapt at runtime, span embedded devices, edge infrastructure and the cloud, that people work with and trust, and that increasingly answer to regulation. This includes understanding how AI technologies and data-informed software development with a human-centred perspective can change the engineering of products and software infrastructures.

The positions are open in any of the software engineering and software technology research areas of interest to the centres, which include:

  • AI for Software Engineering and Software Engineering for AI

  • Software Architecture and Design, including Architecting for AI Systems and AI-assisted Architecting

  • LLM-based, Agentic, and Multi-agent Software Systems

  • Human-AI collaboration in Software Development

  • Software Engineering for Physical AI and Embodied Systems

  • Self-Adaptive and Autonomous Software Systems

  • AI Orchestration and Infrastructure for AI Compute Offloading

  • Software Engineering for Embedded, Cyber-Physical and IoT-Edge-Cloud Systems

  • Governance, Compliance and Accountability of AI-Enabled Software

  • Human-Centred and Socio-Technical Software Engineering

  • Software Testing and Quality Assurance

  • Software Operation, Evolution, Maintenance, Recovery and Modernization

  • Software Reliability Engineering

  • Empirical Software Engineering

  • Requirements Engineering, Specification, and Modelling

 

Who we are looking for

We are looking for candidates who have demonstrated research excellence appropriate to their career stage, who show a clear path towards an independent and internationally recognised research programme, and who are able and willing to contribute to competitive national and international funding applications. We also expect an interest in working across disciplines, in supervising students and junior researchers, and in teaching and advising in software engineering at all levels.

We expect applicants to hold a PhD in software engineering, computer science or a closely related discipline, completed before the application deadline. 

For the tenure-track assistant professor positions we expect at least one year of research experience beyond the PhD, gained in academia, at a research institute or in industry. Applicants must demonstrate a higher level of achievement in research and related professional activities than generally expected of assistant professor applicants, as well as the potential to attain international research excellence within their field and meet the criteria for employment as an associate professor during the tenure track assistant professorship. 

For the associate professor positions we expect a research and teaching record corresponding to several years of independent work after the PhD, including documented teaching and supervision experience.

We particularly welcome applications from candidates who publish in leading venues in the field, such as ICSE, FSE, ASE, ICSA, ECSA, MLSys, DATE, RE, SEAMS, ICSME, SANER, MODELS, ESEM, ICPE and CAiSE, EICS; and in journals such as TSE, TOSEM, EMSE, JSS, IST and IEEE Software.

Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of Danish is not a requirement, and successful applicants will be offered Danish language courses.

 

Workplace description

The University of Southern Denmark

The University of Southern Denmark is one of the youngest universities in Denmark, founded in 1966. The university is founded around the goal of providing the right knowledge at the right time to support society. The university targets major, complex societal problems of a cross-disciplinary nature such as climate, welfare, health and technology, tackling these in collaboration across faculties.

The Faculty of Engineering

The Faculty of Engineering is driven by the urge to create value for and with society, by curiosity and by the will to create that which only a few could imagine would be possible. Through research, education and collaboration, it is the ambition of the faculty to nurture talent, address challenges, create possibilities, and promote sustainable development. The faculty is strongly engaged with national and international industries and organizations over a broad range of technical domains.

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute

The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute is an internationally recognized institute, which has maintained a leading position in robotics for more than three decades. The department is the 2nd largest department at SDU, with more than 230 staff members and 1500 students. The institute has over the last decades expanded its activities in interactive technologies, artificial intelligence, and software engineering including building several strong research centres at the SDU campuses in Odense and Sønderborg and with the new centre also in Vejle. Thereby, the institute today covers a wide range of areas in robotics, software, AI, and applied informatics.

 

Curious?

If you are interested in learning more about the position, please contact:

  • Torben Worm (Head of Centres): tow@mmmi.sdu.dk

  • Mikkel Baun Kjærgaard (Vice-Head of Centres): mbkj@mmmi.sdu.dk

  • Mahyar Tourchi Moghaddam (Associate Professor): mtmo@mmmi.sdu.dk

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application procedure

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and an application must include: 

  • Cover letter.

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (copy of original and official English translation).

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Up to five most relevant publications to the position.

  • A research statement.

  • For assistant professor applicants: Summary and documentation of experience in teaching

  • For associate professor applicants: Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

  • Up to three reference letters may be included (optional).

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included (optional).

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is September 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

Tenure Track at the Faculty of Engineering, SDU
The Faculty of Engineering at SDU offers an attractive tenure track programme aimed at the most talented scholars who have established a high level in their current research and other professional work, and those who possess exceptional potential to achieve the highest international level within their research area.

Candidates enter at the assistant professor level and, upon successful completion, will be promoted to a permanent position as associate professor, subject to a positive assessment by an expert committee.  

This evaluation is based on an overall assessment of the candidate's academic achievements and potential. Indicators of relevant scholarly merits include documented ability to develop an independent and internationally recognized research profile, deliver high-quality teaching and supervision, contribute actively to the academic community, and demonstrate the potential to secure competitive external research funding and build an ambitious research programme. The evaluation may also consider the candidate's contributions to the strategic and organizational development of the department, including a willingness to engage in academic leadership and administrative responsibilities.

As part of the tenure-track programme, the Assistant Professor is expected to complete SDU's Lecturer Training Programme before the evaluation, unless an equivalent university-level programme has already been completed at another institution.

The programme includes annual performance reviews, a midterm evaluation by an expert panel, and a final academic assessment. If the final assessment is positive, the candidate will progress to a permanent position as associate professor. If the final evaluation is negative, the assistant professor may request one additional assessment within the last six months of employment. The tenure track period may be extended in connection with maternity, paternity, or adoption leave.

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period. 

Appointment as a tenure track assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 4-year period, with guaranteed assessment for a permanent position as associate professor during the final year of employment.

Appointment as an associate professor is permanent.

Employment requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment, as well as scientific and teaching qualifications commensurate with the position level. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state included the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor, tenure track assistant professor, or associate professor as described therein. 

During employment at assistant professor level (incl. tenure track), the candidate will complete the Lecturer Training Programme.

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. jobs.title: Montør av Plasthaller. Installation Worker for Fabric Halls and Steel Construction
jobs.description:
We are a company working with the assembly, disassembly and maintenance of fabric halls (PVC halls) and warehouse halls of all sizes and for various purposes throughout Norway, and occasionally abroad. We are now looking for additional employees to join our installation team.

Hva vi ser etter

We are looking for motivated and hardworking people who are not afraid to take responsibility and get the job done.

You enjoy physical work and working at height, and you are comfortable using lifts and working on construction sites.

You like travelling and working at different locations around Norway.

You can work independently, while also working well as part of a team.

You are reliable, engaged and take pride in your work.

You enjoy challenges and want to learn and develop in a professional working environment.

Experience with steel construction assembly and/or installation of fabric halls (PVC halls) is a strong advantage.

You must be able to understand and communicate safety instructions in English .

Norwegian language skills are a strong advantage.

A valid driving licence (class B) is required.

Lift and forklift certificates are an advantage, but not required -- training can be provided.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Assembly and disassembly of fabric halls (PVC halls) in various sizes and types.

This includes installation of steel structures and PVC fabric as cladding.

A lot of the work is performed at height using lifts, so fear of heights is not suitable for this job.

Steel structures are assembled on the ground, lifted into position using a crane, and completed before the fabric is installed.

The work also includes a significant amount of manual tasks such as measuring and anchoring base plates, assembling small and large steel components, and tensioning the fabric.

Extensive travel is required, as we carry out assignments ranging from one-day repair jobs to large projects lasting several weeks, all across Norway.

Vi tilbyr

We offer full training and exciting challenges in a growing company.

All necessary courses and certifications are provided, so you will be properly trained for the job.

We offer competitive salary and good working conditions.

You will have an independent and varied job with freedom under responsibility and the opportunity to develop your skills.

The position involves extensive travel, allowing you to experience many different locations, work at varied sites, and meet new people all the time.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We are a well-established and growing company specialising in all aspects of fabric halls, including assembly, disassembly, relocation and maintenance of fabric halls and warehouse halls of all sizes and applications.

With our office and warehouse in Krøderen, we deliver projects across Norway and occasionally abroad, offering varied workdays and exciting challenges.

We work with both small and large clients within industries such as industry, agriculture, transport and logistics.

Today, our team consists of 18 skilled installation workers and 10 fully equipped service vehicles, providing the right tools and support to deliver high-quality work.

Founded in 2005, we have nearly 20 years of experience and are a stable employer with strong expertise in our field.

Our vision is to build high-quality solutions and create a great workplace for everyone, while striving to be the best in our industry through quality, safety and teamwork.

The Northern Lights Village brand was born in 2016 and since then we have opened three resorts in Finnish Lapland. We pride ourselves in delivering consistently warm and personalized service to our guests. Everyone working at the Northern Lights Village embraces this mission with great care and responsibility. ABOUT THE ROLE

The Waiter / Waitress position entails delivering exceptional dining service to our guests. You will work closely with our kitchen to ensure that every meal is a memorable part of the Northern Lights Village experience.

You should be able to work quickly, answer customer queries and take and deliver orders. You should possess a polite and charismatic character.
This position requires someone who can manage a high-paced environment with grace, effectively communicate with an international clientele, and contribute positively to our team's dynamic.

Our restaurants serve mainly buffet breakfast, lunch and dinner, with occasional à la carte-reservations taking place.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Pay, Duration and Benefits

jobs.title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
jobs.description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.
