We are seeking a highly motivated, hands-on, and people-focused Warehouse Supervisor to work alongside the Warehouse Manager in leading and managing our warehouse operations. The Warehouse Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operation of the warehouse, ensuring the efficient receipt, storage, preparation, and dispatch of fresh produce. The role involves supervising warehouse staff, maintaining food safety standards, managing stock levels, and ensuring all inbound and outbound deliveries are processed accurately and on time. Key Responsibilities Warehouse Operations • Support the Warehouse Manager in the daily operation of the warehouse. • Ensure stock is received, stored, rotated, and managed correctly using FIFO principles. • Monitor warehouse productivity and identify opportunities for operational improvement. • Ensure customer orders are picked, checked, packed, and dispatched accurately and on time. • Maintain high standards of housekeeping, organisation, and warehouse efficiency. • Ensure all areas are operating in line with customer requirements and company standards. Team Leadership • Lead, motivate, and develop warehouse operatives to achieve operational targets. • Assist the Warehouse Manager with recruitment, onboarding, training, and performance management activities. • Monitor employee attendance, timekeeping, productivity, and adherence to company procedures. • Deputise for the Warehouse Manager during periods of absence. • Assist with labour planning, shift scheduling, and resource allocation. • Support warehouse audits, stocktakes, and continuous improvement initiatives. • Provide regular updates on operational performance, staffing issues, and warehouse challenges. Deliveries & Logistics • Coordinate inbound supplier deliveries and outbound customer deliveries. • Investigate delivery discrepancies and implement corrective actions where necessary. • Coordinate the movement of raw vegetables into the preparation area. • Work closely with Production, Purchasing, and Transport teams to meet daily customer requirements and deadlines. • Ensure vehicles are loaded safely, accurately, and efficiently. • Maintain high standards of product quality, presentation, and customer specification compliance. • Minimise picking errors, product damage, and customer complaints. Food Safety & Compliance • Ensure HACCP, hygiene, temperature control, traceability, and quality procedures are followed at all times. Health, Safety & Compliance • Ensure compliance with all company health, safety, and food safety procedures. • Promote a strong safety culture throughout the operation. • Conduct regular workplace inspections and safety audits. • Address safety concerns and hazards promptly. Stock Control & Administration • Carry out regular stock checks and investigate discrepancies. • Monitor stock levels and communicate shortages to relevant departments. • Monitor waste and identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve efficiency.

jobs.title: Socialpædagog søges til Børne- og ungehjem
jobs.description:
Behandlingsinstitutioner Curam søger snarest en socialpædagog til afdeling Grønnebjerg

Curams målgruppe er børn og unge mellem 14-23 år med multiple problemstillinger, herunder omsorgssvigt, udviklingstraume, tilknytningsforstyrrelser, kriminalitet og misbrug. Vi har plads til i alt 15 unge, fordelt på 3 afdelinger, ligesom vi har ansvaret for 4 unge der bor i egen bolig, alle i Skibby. Stillingen er ledig i vores afdeling Grønnebjerg i Kirke Såby, og har plads til 5 unge mellem 14-17 år.

Arbejdestiden er mellem 7.00-23.00 i et 4 ugers rul, og laves i samarbejde med de øvrige ansatte. Man skal være indstillet på at arbejde 2-4 eftermiddag/after pr uge og mindst en weekend (fredag/lørdag eller lørdag/søndag) pr. måned. Natarbejde kommer ikke på tale, da vi har faste nattevagter.

Ansøger med kendskab til arbejdet med udsatte børn og unge vil blive foretrukket, ligesom kendskab til misbrugsproblematikker og udadreagerende adfærd er en klar fordel.

Robusthed, ro, empati og mentaliseringskompetncer, er sammen med en respektfuld og anerkendende tilgang til målgruppen og dennes familie, nødvendige kompetencer.

Ansvarlighed og ordentlighed er en forudsætning, ligesom humor og samarbejdsevne er centrale elementer for den rette ansøger. 

Vi tilbyder god løn, oplæring, kurser og supervision, ligesom der er tilrettelagt en 1-årig intern efteruddannelse for den samlede personalegruppe med opstart maj 2026. Desuden vægter vi en god omgangstone, frihed under ansvar, kollegial sparring og har nogle super gode fysiske rammer, både til personalet og de unge.

Vi arbejder ud fra en tilknytningsteoretisk, systemisk narrativ og kropsorienteret tilgang.

Værdigrundlag:

  • Vi tror på, at alle børn og unge har ressourcer og styrker og alle gør det bedst de kan.

  • Vi tror på, at enhver person har ret til at blive behandlet individuelt ud fra en særligt tilrettelagt og målrettet behandlingstænkning, der tager højde for barnet/den unges livshistorie, følelsesmæssige samt kognitive forudsætninger for at kunne indgå i kontakt og relation med sin omverden.

  • Vi tror på, at professionelle, som er autentiske, træder i karakter, og som ikke er bange for at involvere sig og sætte sig selv i spil, kan gøre en forskel.

  • Vi tror på, at positive forandringer bedst skabes i et positivt defineret felt. Vi tager altid udgangspunkt i det enkelte menneske og lægger vægt på, at alle bliver mødt med en forståelse for de vanskeligheder barnet/den unge har med sig.

jobs.title: True Dates Production Operator
jobs.description:
True Co. was founded in 2017 and began as an entrepreneurial journey in the founders’ kitchen, where they experimented with developing plastic-free chewing gum. The idea of revolutionizing snacking through more natural alternatives has since developed into a company that today also produces True Dates. The products are sold in more than 50 countries and the company is growing. True Co. is therefore looking for operators for newly established shifts at the True Dates factory in Glostrup at Formervangen 13. Working hours will be 21.55 to 07.10 Monday to Thursday

Your primary tasks

  • Physical production, operation, and monitoring of production and processing equipment.

  • Rotation between stations and different parts of the process is a natural part of the work.

  • Ongoing checks, measurements, and record-keeping in accordance with documented standards.

  • Troubleshooting and problem-solving in collaboration with the maintenance team.

  • Cleaning and preparation of equipment and the production area.

  • Ensuring quality and food safety.

  • Ad hoc tasks related to production, warehouse, and cleaning depending on needs.

Qualifications

  • You enjoy working in a dynamic work environment with clear production targets and requirements for tasty products, while actively contributing to maintaining high food safety standards.

  • You like working in teams where colleagues help each other to complete tasks.

  • Not a requirement but a plus if you have experience as a process operator, industrial operator, process technologist, or similar. Experience from food production or another regulated environment is an advantage.

  • You have a mechanical/technical interest.

  • You can read and understand English, as documentation, instructions, and the corporate language is English.

The work is carried out under controlled conditions, and therefore requirements apply regarding personal hygiene and mandatory clothing provided by the company.

We offer

  • Thorough training in operating machines.

  • Training in producing food according to GMP standards.

  • Competitive salary

O’Carroll Engineering is an innovative, off-site modular engineering steel fabrication specialist. Established in 1990 we combine a highly skilled workforce with technologically advanced and digital fabrication methods to produce efficient-install solutions to industrial and construction markets. Specialists in modular walkways and access systems, stairs and modular apartment balconies. O’Carroll Engineering is offering an opportunity to join our 165+ strong, highly skilled team and be a part of an innovative, technology-driven, industry-leading manufacturer. Our team members are at the core of our growth and we endeavour to strike the best possible work-life balance along with training and advancement opportunities to ensure we challenge and motivate employees. Located in one of Ireland's most vibrant and scenic towns Killarney, we are proud that the majority of our staff have over five years of service with us. For more information visit www.ocarrollengineering.com. We are expanding our innovative, award-winning team and currently seeking a Metal Fabricator. The Metal Fabricator is part of the team of Fabrication Technicians, Metal Fabricators and Welders who fit and weld steel components. The Metal Fabricator will primarily work from technical drawings to fabricate, fit and tack weld competent parts before the item is moved on for welding. The role will require the fabrication of components using a jig. The Metal Fabricator will work under the direction of the workshop supervisors to produce components to the standard required. Main duties: Lead and interpret technical drawings to produce steel components Take measurements to ensure accuracy Cutting steel as required Use welder to tack components Ensure components are as per the specification required Work from jigs as required Operate power and hand tools to complete jobs Run machines as required to complete jobs Maintain all health and safety standards at all times This list is not exhaustive and duties may be amended, added or removed Minimum requirements of Fabricator: Experience in the fabrication of metal components from technical drawings Working knowledge of steel Previous experience in a manufacturing or production environment Team player Proven ability to multi-task Flexibility to move between projects The Metal Fabricator role requires a minimum of 39 hours per week, Monday to Friday. A reasonable level of overtime may be required at morning, evening or weekend time to ensure the fulfilment of the requirements of this role.

jobs.title: Mid-Market Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the full customer lifecycle—new logo, expansion, and renewal—as the single account owner for your book of business, with responsibility for ensuring credits sold translate into credits consumed

 - Design and build workflow solutions live with customers: the discovery is the demo, not the slide deck—you’ll run discovery, design current-to-future-state workflow architecture, and co-build in Notion with the customer

 - Partner with BDRs on target account planning and co-own the outbound motion for your book, running direct outreach to priority stakeholders alongside BDR-sourced pipeline

 - Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path

 - Guide customers through early implementation with a clear adoption plan and handoff to Outcomes Architects for ongoing multi-workflow expansion

 - Partner with Outcomes Architects (OA) on onboarding, adoption plans, expansion strategies, and renewal execution—owning the commercial arc while OAs drive day-to-day workflow adoption
   
   


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - Experience in selling technical products to technical buyers in the Mid-Market segment (500-2999 employees)

 - Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot in front of a customer without a specialist in the room

 - Strong discovery and qualification instincts, with the ability to map customer workflows and translate them into commercial outcomes and adoption plans

 - Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder interactions including procurement, legal, and security review cycles

 - You can own the room—you operate with agency and urgency to bring new ideas and workflows to our customers and present simple ways to solve complex problems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working

 - Native or bilingual-level Korean fluency and business-level English proficiency
   
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new logo acquisition and expansion motions

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or CS team as part of an integrated customer motion

jobs.description:
About the role

For more than 60 years, Complex has been known for delivering award winning construction projects across the built environment.


Our skillful execution of quality projects is an expression of our personal and professional commitment to connecting and enhancing communities.


We are looking for a Lead Estimator, this role will provide support and technical advice to our estimating team, deliver accurate, competitive, and well-documented cost estimates for civil & construction projects, while also providing oversight and tender coordination to the estimating team.


The Lead Estimator is a critical role that remains hands-on in the preparation of tenders while contributing to pricing strategy, subcontractor engagement, and achieving tendering milestones.


Key responsibilities

  • Prepare accurate and competitive cost estimates, budgets, and scopes of work for civil construction tenders
  • Review tender documentation (drawings, specifications, RFTs, contracts) to confirm scope, risks, and opportunities
  • Conduct and/or coordinate site inspections to assess conditions and identify construction risks
  • Perform and review quantity take-offs using Benchmark, Revu, and Excel
  • Prepare detailed cost build-ups, subcontractor comparisons, and pricing reconciliations
  • Analyse historical project data to support pricing accuracy and continuous improvement
  • Promote consistent estimating methodologies, tools, and documentation standards
  • Maintain effective working relationships with key subcontractors and suppliers

About you

  • Minimum 5 years' experience in commercial construction / civil infrastructure estimating
  • Demonstrated experience preparing and leading complex civil tenders
  • Strong understanding of civil, building and construction methodologies, contract review and risk identification, and cost planning and pricing strategy
  • Proven ability to mentor and support junior and mid-level estimators
  • High-level competency in Benchmark, Bluebeam Revu, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft Project (Intermediate level)
  • Ability to manage multiple tenders and competing deadlines
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Well-developed interpersonal, negotiation, and organisational skills

jobs.title: Student Assistant– Cyber Security & Compliance
jobs.description:
Want to gain hands-on experience within cyber security and compliance, in critical IT infrastructure?

Join our Infrastructure & Security team and get hands-on experience with vulnerability management, audits, access governance, security reporting, and compliance activities. You'll work alongside experienced specialists and help protect business-critical systems while building valuable real-world skills.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

The Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnet, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet.

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centers, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.

You can read more about Nordic RCC and the services we deliver on our website https://nordic-rcc.net/ 

Right now, we are looking for a Student Assistant – Cyber Security & Compliance who likes to make a difference!

Job description:

We are looking for a Student Assistant to support the Infrastructure & Security team. The role will work closely with the Cyber Security and Compliance functions, helping maintain governance processes, security operations, reporting, and documentation while gaining practical experience within enterprise IT security and compliance. The position supports activities within vulnerability management, access governance, audits, and security reporting.

Responsibilities:

Security Operations Support

  • Support vulnerability management activities and follow up on remediation actions.

  • Assist with endpoint compliance reviews and Intune-related administrative activities.

  • Support vulnerability management activities and follow up on remediation actions.

  • Coordinate follow-up with system owners and suppliers regarding security findings.

Compliance & Audit Support

  • Collect, organize, and maintain audit evidence.

  • Support preparation for internal and external audits.

  • Maintain compliance documentation and evidence repositories.

  • Track audit findings and remediation activities.

Access Management & Governance

  • Assist with periodic access reviews.

  • Track completion of access review activities.

  • Help maintain governance processes and security controls documentation.

Documentation & Process Management

  • Update security procedures, standards, and runbooks.

  • Maintain SharePoint-based documentation repositories.

  • Ensure documents are reviewed and updated according to governance requirements.

Requirements:

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree within IT, Cyber Security, Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Structured and detail-oriented approach to work.

  • Strong analytical and documentation skills.

  • Experience with Microsoft 365, Excel, and SharePoint is an advantage.

  • Interest in cyber security, governance, risk, and compliance.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements.

What we offer

You will be joining a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently 25 nationalities with over 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We offer workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance, including the possibility to work from home some of the time. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

Note:

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than 30/09/2026. We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include a photograph in your CV or any other materials.

If you have any questions, please contact Patrick Frømming, Manager, Infrastructure & Security (PFN@nordic-rcc.net).

jobs.description:
As market leaders and experts in luxury furniture design, we take pride in our commitment to quality and innovation.

For over 60 years, Nick Scali has been a nationally recognized household name in the Australian furniture industry. Following our acquisition of Plush Sofas in late 2021, we now operate over 110 showrooms across Australia and New Zealand, with exciting plans for further expansion in 2025.

Join an iconic Australian retail organization and be part of an international ASX-listed company that values career development in a supportive team environment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary with generous uncapped commission.

Job Description

We are looking for a passionate and dynamic Retail Store Manager for our Midland Showroom to lead, coach, and inspire the sales team to achieve individual and team sales targets.

In this role, you will create a positive and motivating environment while ensuring operational excellence in your showroom.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and develop the showroom sales team, fostering a culture of positivity and collaboration.
  • Drive sales performance by utilizing your expertise in customer service and product knowledge.
  • Ensure timely resolution of customer complaints and adherence to company policies and procedures.
  • Collaborate with the Regional Sales Manager to develop and implement strategies that maximize sales and enhance customer satisfaction.
  • Maintain showroom standards, ensuring compliance with visual merchandising and safety regulations.

Qualifications

  • Previous sales experience, ideally selling furniture or high-value items such as jewellery, cars, bedding, luxury goods / travel, etc.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a positive attitude and a growth mindset.
  • Excellent organizational abilities and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Commitment to coaching and developing team members for success.

jobs.title: Sales Recruiter
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Sales Recruiter you’ll help build the next evolution of our go-to-market organization. You’ll recruit for new and evolving customer-facing roles—including Business Development Representatives, Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects, and Forward Deployed Engineers—that bring stronger technical fluency, deeper customer ownership, and fewer handoffs to enterprise selling. You’ll partner with Sales leaders and cross-functional teams to turn an emerging business strategy into clear profiles, thoughtful processes, and exceptional hires.

You will use Notion every day in the same way our customers do, giving you firsthand insight into the workflows and AI transformation behind the roles you are hiring for. You will also help build a new GTM motion at the intersection of AI, workflow design, enterprise transformation, and customer outcomes. The work requires craft, clarity, speed, and strong judgment, balancing business urgency with a high bar for talent density.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Build trusted partnerships with Sales leaders, advising on role definition, search strategy, assessment design, and hiring decisions for new and evolving teams.

 - Deliver high-quality hires across the next generation of GTM roles, from sourcing through close, while creating a thoughtful, inclusive, and high-touch candidate experience.

 - Translate Notion’s product love, AI opportunity, and customer motion into accurate candidate narratives that help the right people self-select in.

 - Use talent-market research, mapping, and recruiting data to improve hiring strategy and decision quality.

 - Raise the quality and consistency of the hiring system through structured intake, calibration, debriefs, manager coaching, and sourcing strategies that expand representation.

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Demonstrated success recruiting across GTM searches, with the judgment to learn and represent evolving role profiles accurately.

 - Ability to turn business strategy into clear candidate profiles, search plans, and objective assessment criteria—and to influence senior leaders toward strong decisions.

 - Strong sourcing, market-mapping, and closing instincts across various Sales disciplines.

 - Operational rigor and comfort using data to diagnose pipeline health, measure impact, and improve the candidate and hiring-manager experience.

 - Curiosity, learning agility, and a hands-on approach to AI tools: you use them to think better, improve recruiting workflows, and make your work easier for others to build on. 

 

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $136,000 - $170,000 per year.

 

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21

 

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Renewables Project Scheduler
jobs.description:
Apply

Description

Job Summary:

The BESS Project Scheduler is responsible for developing, maintaining, and analyzing detailed project schedules for Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects. This role plays a critical part in ensuring projects are delivered on time by providing accurate schedule forecasts, identifying risks, and supporting project teams with data-driven insights across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and energization phases. This role requires a strong leader that will take ownership of driving accurate and up to date scheduling across multiple projects as well as taking initiative to drive process improvements where there is an opportunity to improve.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain integrated project schedules for BESS projects from NTP through COD
  • Build schedules covering engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, civil, electrical, installation, commissioning, and grid interconnection
  • Collaborate with Project Managers, Construction Managers, OEMs, and subcontractors to validate logic, durations, and sequencing
  • Perform critical path analysis, float analysis, and schedule risk assessments
  • Track project progress and update schedules using actuals, forecasts, and recovery plans
  • Identify schedule impacts related to procurement delays, permitting, weather, interconnection, or change orders
  • Prepare schedule narratives, look-ahead schedules, and progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Support claims, change management, and time-impact analyses as required
  • Ensure schedules align with contract milestones, EPC agreements, and owner requirements
  • Maintain schedule standards, templates, and best practices across the portfolio
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements

  • Bachelorâs degree in construction management, Engineering, Project Management, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 5+ years of project scheduling experience in utility-scale energy, power generation, or heavy civil construction
  • Direct experience supporting BESS, solar, wind, or substation projects
  • Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 (required)
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Project and Excel
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, procurement lead times, and commissioning activities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with EPC contracts and utility-scale energy storage projects
  • Knowledge of battery OEM workflows (manufacturing, FAT, shipping, commissioning)
  • Familiarity with Power BI or other reporting/analytics tools
  • Experience supporting schedule recovery plans and delay analysis
  • Experience developing resource-loaded and cost-loaded schedules
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present schedule data clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Work Environment/Physical Requirements

  • Combination of office, remote, and active construction site environments
  • Ability to work extended hours during critical project phases
  • Working in all weather conditions
  • Must be able to lift more than 50 lbs.
  • May require overtime, nights, or weekends based on project needs

Pre-Employment Requirements

Candidates must successfully complete a background check and drug screening prior to hiring. This role is considered safety-sensitive and may be subject to ongoing drug and testing in compliance with company policy and regulatory requirements.

Location: Location specific; travel up to 50%

Opis poslova
Obavljat će poslove organiziranja, provođenja i kontrole tehnološko-preventivnog procesa proizvodnje tijekom uzgoja podmlatka, proizvodnje rasplodnih jaja, likvidacije jaja te za remonta farme za vrijeme međuturnusne stanke. Vođenja evidencije u cjelokupnom procesu proizvodnje. Osiguravanja provođenja propisanih mjera zaštite na radu i protupožarne zaštite. jobs.title: Director of Product Design
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


We're looking for a Director, Product Design to lead the day-to-day operations of Replit's Product Design organization, reporting to the Co-Founder & Head of Design.

This is a true player-coach role for someone who loves building products as much as leading people. You'll lead and develop a talented team of product designers while remaining deeply embedded in the work itself. You'll whiteboard with designers, navigate complex product decisions.

The Co-Founder & Head of Design remains closely involved in design critique and product quality. Your role is to lead the day-to-day design organization by creating the structure, alignment, and momentum that enable exceptional work. You'll stay two to three layers deeper than the Co-Founder & Head of Design on active initiatives, surfacing the context, tradeoffs, and insights needed to make thoughtful decisions without requiring constant immersion in every project.

Success in this role requires exceptional product judgment, strong design taste, technical fluency, and a collaborative approach. You're someone who naturally connects disciplines, elevates the people around you, and makes both the work and the team better every day.

 
 


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Lead the day-to-day operations of Replit's Product Design organization, ensuring work is aligned, prioritized, and delivered to an exceptionally high standard.

 - Manage, mentor, and develop a team of product designers, helping them grow their craft, confidence, and impact.

 - Shape and elevate the customer journey

 - Work alongside designers every day by whiteboarding ideas, exploring alternatives, reviewing work in progress, and solving complex product and interaction challenges.

 - Stay deeply informed across active initiatives, surfacing the context and insights that enable the Co-Founder & Head of Design to engage quickly in meaningful design critique and high-impact product decisions.

 - Raise the quality of product design through thoughtful feedback, exceptional craft, and strong design taste.

 - Help evolve Replit's design practices, workflows, and team culture while preserving the speed and flexibility of a high-growth company.

 - Recruit, hire, and onboard exceptional product design talent as the organization grows.

 
 


WHO YOU ARE

You're a builder first and a manager second.

You enjoy being close to the work, helping designers think through difficult problems, and making good teams even better. You're equally comfortable sketching ideas on a whiteboard, giving thoughtful design feedback, coaching a designer through a difficult challenge, or partnering with engineering on implementation details.

You combine exceptional product judgment with strong design taste and technical fluency. You're collaborative, humble, curious, and energized by helping great work happen.

 
 


EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

 - Significant experience leading product design teams within high-growth technology companies.

 - Proven ability to balance people leadership with meaningful hands-on product design contribution.

 - A portfolio demonstrating exceptional craft, interaction design, product thinking, and systems thinking.

 - Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering to deliver technically sophisticated products.

 - Demonstrated success leading cross-functional product development in fast-moving environments.

 - Exceptional communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.

 - Strong design taste, sound judgment, and a bias toward action.

 - Experience simplifying complex technical products into elegant, approachable user experiences.

 
 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience designing developer tools, technical products, or software creation platforms.

 - Experience building AI-powered products or AI-native workflows.

 - Coding experience or strong technical curiosity.

 - Experience growing design teams in startup or scale-up environments.

 - Active use of AI throughout your design process.

 
 


WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

This isn't a traditional design leadership role.

We're looking for someone who thrives in the work, not above it. Someone who enjoys solving problems alongside designers, building strong partnerships across Product and Engineering, and bringing the depth of context that allows the Co-Founder & Head of Design to focus on the moments where their perspective has the greatest impact.

This is a role for someone who is excited by complex product challenges, passionate about developing exceptional designers, and motivated by building products that make powerful technology feel intuitive.



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.description:
After nearly nine years of technology development, we are entering an important stage of growth. We are transitioning from low-rate engineering builds towards industrialisation, pre-series manufacturing and serial production.

Work tasks: Lead the transition from engineering builds through pre-series and into scalable serial production
Establish and scale Golbriak Space’s manufacturing, assembly, integration and testing capability in Estonia Develop repeatable production processes, routings, work instructions, acceptance criteria and engineering-to-production transfer practices Define production layouts, workstations, tooling, fixtures, equipment and test infrastructure Own the end-to-end manufacturing flow, from incoming inspection and material planning to final acceptance and shipping Implement production planning, capacity management, inventory control, ERP/MRP tools and relevant manufacturing metrics Oversee optical, electronic, mechanical and system-level assembly, integration, verification and testing Define and manage supplier, outsourcing and make-or-buy strategies for components and manufacturing activities Establish production and quality processes aligned with ISO 9001 principles, including traceability, change control and non-conformance management Identify and resolve manufacturing, testing, capacity and supply-chain risks and bottlenecks Drive continuous improvement across quality, yield, cycle time, cost and delivery performance Build, lead and develop the manufacturing and operations team as production scales

We offer: A key leadership role with ownership of Golbriak Space’s manufacturing and industrialisation function
The opportunity to build a production facility and manufacturing capability from the ground up Direct involvement in taking advanced optical communication technology into serial production Close cooperation with the founders and a multidisciplinary engineering team A high level of autonomy and the ability to shape manufacturing systems, facilities, supplier strategy and team capability An international, technically ambitious and hands-on working environment A monthly gross salary of €4,655–€5,985, depending on experience and Relocation support to Estonia if required Flexible working hours, consistent with operational and team needs

Other requirements: Proven experience establishing or significantly scaling a manufacturing facility or function
Experience transferring complex hardware products from engineering builds through pre-series and into repeatable production Hands-on experience with industrialisation, production ramp-ups, assembly, integration and testing Strong understanding of production workflows, manufacturing-process development, test infrastructure and production readiness Experience defining production layouts, workstations, tooling, fixtures and equipment requirements Experience introducing work instructions, routings, production records, traceability and configuration controls Experience with production planning, capacity analysis, inventory management, material flow and ERP/MRP systems Experience developing make-or-buy strategies and managing specialised suppliers or contract manufacturers Knowledge of structured production and quality processes aligned with ISO 9001 or an equivalent framework Understanding of non-conformance management, corrective actions and controlled engineering changes Experience building, leading and developing manufacturing or operations teams Ability to demonstrate your personal contribution and measurable results from previous industrialisation or production scale-up work Ability to operate effectively at both strategic and hands-on levels Strong cross-functional coordination, prioritisation and problem-solving skills A builder’s mindset and motivation to create new manufacturing capability Professional fluency in English Willingness to reside in Estonia and work primarily onsite in Tallinn Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate results such as establishing a production facility, transferring hardware into serial production, increasing capacity or throughput, improving quality and delivery performance, implementing manufacturing systems, developing test infrastructure, qualifying suppliers or building a production team.

jobs.title: RTL Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Come work with a multidisciplinary engineering team focused on delivering world-class optical telecommunication systems for space, airborne and ground applications.

Work tasks: Key Responsibilities:
Develop, maintain and improve RTL modules in VHDL Implement high-speed digital logic for communication systems Create simulations and testbenches to verify RTL behaviour Verify and validate designs against technical and system requirements Use Quartus, GHDL and GTKWave as part of the development and verification workflow Investigate and resolve RTL, integration and system-level issues Maintain clear code documentation and verification records Debug and validate FPGA designs on physical hardware Support board bring-up and hardware integration Work with LVDS, Ethernet and other high-speed digital interfaces Support integration between Altera FPGAs and STM32 microcontrollers through CAN interfaces Use laboratory equipment, including high-speed oscilloscopes, power supplies and multimeters Support system-level testing, verification and product qualification Contribute to the integration of custom software-defined radio functionality Work closely with electronics, embedded software and systems engineers Coordinate with electronics engineers on FPGA pinout integration and chip interconnections Translate system and communication requirements into practical RTL implementations Maintain FPGA architecture, interface, verification and code documentation Provide practical input into the development and improvement of the communication system

We offer: We offer a competitive salary
Work/life balance with the possibility of flexible hours Bonuses based on performance The opportunity to work in a talented and dynamic startup environment.

Other requirements: Requirements:
A bachelor’s degree in electronics, computer engineering, telecommunications or another relevant technical field At least one year of practical RTL or FPGA development experience Practical experience with RTL design in VHDL Experience maintaining, improving and developing RTL modules Experience creating and using simulations and testbenches Experience debugging FPGA designs on physical hardware Experience designing long, high-speed processing pipelines Understanding of clock recovery and high-speed digital data paths Understanding of digital communication systems and network protocol layers Familiarity with FPGA-based communication interfaces Ability to use technical documentation, electronic schematics and component datasheets A structured approach to verification, debugging and technical documentation Ability to work independently while recognising when collaboration or support is needed Readiness to work in a startup environment where priorities and technical requirements may evolve Professional working proficiency in English at C1 level or equivalent University or personal projects may be considered as relevant experience when they include substantial FPGA-based development, such as developing a software-defined radio or a similarly complex system. Practical RTL design experience is essential for this position. Nice to have: Experience with Altera FPGA platforms Experience using Quartus, GHDL or GTKWave Experience with LVDS and Ethernet interfaces Experience with PCIe or similar high-speed technologies Understanding of Ethernet physical and data-link layers, including PHY and MAC functionality Experience with digital signal processing or high-speed data processing Experience developing FPGA-based software-defined radio systems Experience integrating FPGAs with microcontrollers or other electronic components Experience coordinating FPGA pinouts and chip interconnections with electronics engineers Experience in telecommunications, optical communication or signal processing Experience developing high-reliability or radiation-resilient digital logic Experience in aerospace, defence or another high-reliability engineering environment

Handling: Move carcasses and meat portions safely around the boning hall without damaging the product. Maintenance: Sharpen cutting tools regularly and keep work areas clean. Physical Fitness: High physical stamina, ability to stand for long shifts (e.g., 39-hour standard work weeks), and strength to lift heavy meat cuts. Environment: Comfort working in a fast-paced, repetitive, and cold refrigerated factory environment. Safety & Hygiene: Strict adherence to food safety, hygiene regulations, and health and safety procedures.

jobs.title: Barselsvikar som idrætskoordinator i socialpsykiatrien
jobs.description:
Så er chancen her for at blive vores nye idrætskoordinator i en periode. Vores nuværende idrætskoordinator skal på barsel og vi søger derfor hendes afløser i perioden fra d 1-11 2026 til forventelig sommer 2027.

Har du erfaring med idræt og brænder du for at udvikle fællesskaber for mennesker med psykiske sårbarheder?

Du vil være en del af socialpsykiatrien, som består af et bofællesskab, et midlertidigt botilbud for unge samt dagsbeskæftigelse, bostøtte og café. Derudover er der et senhjerneskadeområde ligeledes med dagsbeskæftigelse og bostøtte.

Idrætskoordinatoren skal dække ovenstående områder.

Derudover har psykiatrien en meget velfungerende idrætsforening, LIF, - Limfjordens idrætsforening. Foreningen blev stiftet i september 2015 med henblik på at skabe et meningsfuldt og aktivt fællesskab for psykisk sårbare borgere i Morsø kommune. Foreningen er under Dansk Arbejder Idræt og har et samarbejde med Idræt for Sindet foreninger i hele Danmark.

Som Idrætskoordinator skal du arbejde tæt sammen tæt med bestyrelsen i idrætsforeningen om at arrangere aktiviteter og arrangementer både lokalt og ved deltagelse i idrætsarrangementer/stævner i andre kommuner sammen med borgerne.

Som idrætskoordinator bliver du både koordinator, igangsætter, instruktør og støtteperson i foreningen. Der vil også være praktiske opgaver og der vil være administrative opgaver i forhold til driften af LIF.

Fagligt forventer vi, at du;

  • Har en idrætsprofil og en relevant uddannelse, som f.eks pædagog, fysioterapeut, ergoterapeut, lærer eller har en uddannelse indenfor idræt og sundhed eller tilsvarende
  • Har erfaring med frivillige foreninger, enten som træner, instruktør eller lignende og kan indgå i samarbejde med frivillige foreninger
  • Evner at tilpasse din træning og instruktion efter deltagernes niveau og særligt i forhold til ikke idrætsvante mennesker
  • Har erfaring med eller viden om de udfordringer, psykisk sårbare mennesker har i dagligdagen
  • Har erfaring med at motivere andre

Vi forestiller os, at du som person:

  • Er engageret og empatisk og vil møde borgerne med et åbent og anerkendende sind
  • Har et godt og smittende humør
  • Har en indfaldsvinkel, der er motiverende, støttende og inspirerende for den enkelte
  • Har forståelse for forskelligheden båret af respekt for andre
  • Er rolig og tydelig i din kommunikation
  • Brænder for at gøre en forskel
  • Er selvstændig og kan tage ansvar
  • Har det fint med, at mange timer og aktiviteter kan ligge efter kl. 16
  • Kan samarbejde tværfagligt med kollegaer på alle område

 

Vores mission er at styrke borgernes mestring i eget liv, i samspil med det omgivende samfund, så vi bidrager til øget inklusion. Det handler både om at skabe tryghed for borgeren og øget selvstændighed. Vores indsats baserer sig på at møde den enkelte borger, via den nære og anerkendende relation, samt tage udgangspunkt i dennes kompetencer. 

 

Løn- og ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst. Desuden fastsættes lønnen efter aftale og under medvirken af den forhandlingsberettede organisation.

For yderligere oplysninger eller spørgsmål kontakt leder Inge Kappel på tlf. 99 70 66 64.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 17. september 2026.

Samtaler forventes afholdt d 28. september 2026.

Der vil blive søgt en straffeattest inden ansættelsen og denne skal være forenelig med ansættelse.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Assistant Professors and/or Associate Professors in Clinical and Preventive Odontology
jobs.description:
Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark is seeking two motivated individuals for two fixed-term appointments (2 years, up to 37 hours per week, with the possibility of extension). The successful candidates will have the opportunity to contribute to the establishment of the newly established Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology and to play an active role in the development of the upcoming educational programmes for dentists and dental hygienists.

These positions offer a rare opportunity to influence the development of education, research, and clinical teaching from the very beginning, while joining an ambitious academic community dedicated to excellence, innovation, and interdisciplinary collaboration.

About the positions

We are seeking candidates with a broad background in dentistry and an interest in the development of university education.

We welcome applicants with diverse dental competencies and subspecialties, for example within:

  • Cariology and Endodontics

  • Periodontology

  • Prosthodontics

  • Orthodontics

  • Oral Surgery

  • Oral Medicine

  • Paediatric Dentistry

  • Clinical Dentistry in General

  • Preventive Dentistry

  • Digital Dentistry

The decisive factor is not your subspecialty alone, but your commitment to contributing to the development of a modern, research-led education in dentistry.

 

Main responsibilities

 

As part of the establishment and development of the department, you will be expected to contribute actively to:

  • the development of the new Dentistry and Dental Hygiene programmes, which are expected to commence in the summer of 2027

  • the planning and development of courses and teaching activities

  • teaching at both undergraduate and graduate levels

  • teaching dentistry and dental hygiene students

  • the development of clinical learning activities, simulation-based training, and competency-based education

  • student assessment and supervision

  • collaboration with clinical instructors, private training clinics, and other external partners

  • the development of the department’s teaching and learning environment

  • the development and implementation of research projects within clinical and preventive dentistry

  • scientific publishing and dissemination of research findings

  • the development of national and international research collaborations

  • securing external research funding and contributing to grant applications

Teaching will be based on evidence-based dentistry and will emphasize the close integration of basic sciences, clinical skills, and patient care.

Research

The department is concurrently establishing the Research Unit APEX, which aims to build strong national and international research environments within clinical and preventive dentistry.

We are therefore seeking candidates with an interest in research and academic development.

To be successful in this position, we expect you:

  • have documented research experience

  • have published scientific articles in peer-reviewed journals

  • are motivated to further develop your own research profile

  • have an interest in interdisciplinary and international collaboration.

The research component of the position will be tailored to the individual candidate’s qualifications and career stage.

Qualifications

We expect that you:

  • hold a degree in Dentistry

  • have obtained a PhD degree

  • hold Danish authorization to practice as a dentist, or meet the requirements for obtaining Danish authorization

  • combine strong clinical competencies with a well-developed scientific and analytical mindset

  • are motivated to contribute actively to the development of a new dental department

  • thrive in an interdisciplinary university environment

  • possess strong collaborative and interpersonal skills.

In addition, the following qualifications will be considered an advantage:

  • documented teaching experience

  • experience with curriculum development

  • experience supervising students

  • experience from specialist training or other advanced areas of clinical expertise.

For candidates appointed as Assistant Professors, participation in the Lecturer Training Programme (Universitetspædagogikum) is planned as part of the appointment.

 

Appointment to the positions requires academic qualifications at PhD level and in accordance with the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

 

What we offer

You will become part of a growing department with a unique opportunity to make a significant academic and professional impact.

Among other things, we offer:

  • the opportunity to help shape new educational programmes from the ground up

  • a strong research-based university environment

  • close integration of research, clinical practice, and teaching

  • excellent opportunities for academic career development

  • the opportunity to contribute to the establishment and development of the Research Unit APEX

  • an engaged and ambitious collegial environment with a strong focus on quality, collaboration, and innovation.

About the department

The Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) aims to advance and disseminate new knowledge within dentistry through excellent research, research-based education in SDU’s new Dentistry and Dental Hygiene programmes, and close collaboration with the healthcare sector.

The Department will educate the next generation of dentists and dental hygienists through research-based teaching, modern simulation and clinical training, and close engagement with the wider healthcare system, supported by a strong international research environment of the highest academic standard.

Our vision is to create a strong, internationally oriented research and educational environment where clinical excellence, evidence-based practice, and interdisciplinary collaboration go hand in hand.

Application deadline

October 19, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Contact

Further information about the position may be obtained from Professor and Head of Research Torben H. Thygesen, tthygesen@health.sdu.dk, +45 22 34 13 64, or Acting Head of Department and Dean Jakob Grauslund jgrauslund@health.sdu.dk, +45 93 50 70 42.

Salary and terms of employment 

The applicants will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations). 

The position as assistant professor or associate professor is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. 

In addition, a centrally agreed assistant professor or associate professor allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

Application 

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below. 

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply. 

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total): 

  • a motivation letter 

  • a detailed CV 

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma) 

  • a complete and numbered list of publications 

  • 3 for assistant professors, and 6 associate professors, scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file. 

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file. 

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy 

  • a research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work 

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.   

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered. 

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Assessment 

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process.  

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material.  

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves.  

Living and working in Denmark 

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment.  

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark.  

Join us in shaping the future of dentistry

We are seeking ambitious colleagues who wish to contribute to more than teaching alone. We invite dentists with a passion for academic development, research, and education to join us in building a new academic environment and educating the oral healthcare professionals of the future.

Together, we are creating the foundation for Denmark’s newest Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology and shaping the future of dental education and research.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Collaborate with business leaders, department heads, and operational teams to understand business needs, challenges, and opportunities and translate them into clear and actionable requirements. Analyse existing business processes, workflows, systems, and reporting structures to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement across business and operational functions. Document, structure, and prioritise business requirements to support the development and implementation of practical, technology-driven solutions. Support and drive continuous improvement initiatives across the organisation, with a focus on improving efficiency, accuracy, cost effectiveness, and overall business performance. Identify opportunities for automation and AI integration across daily, weekly, and monthly reporting and operational processes. Develop and support automated reporting solutions using Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and other reporting or data visualisation tools. Explore and support the introduction of AI-based tools and automation technologies to reduce manual workload in areas including reporting, data entry, scheduling, forecasting, and operational analysis. Work with internal teams and external IT providers to support the design, development, and implementation of business systems and digital solutions. Support system integration activities to ensure new tools and platforms operate effectively with existing business systems, processes, and workflows. Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure business requirements are clearly communicated, understood, and appropriately delivered. Assist with solution design, testing, deployment, and post-implementation support for new systems and business process changes. Develop and enhance management reporting frameworks, dashboards, and performance tracking tools to support effective, data-driven decision-making. Support the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of data across reporting and operational systems. Promote appropriate data governance practices, including compliance with GDPR and internal data security requirements. Translate technical concepts into clear business language and communicate business requirements effectively to technical stakeholders. Support training, onboarding, documentation, and change management activities to assist with the successful adoption of new systems, processes, and technologies. Promote continuous improvement and digital innovation across the organisation by identifying and supporting smarter and more efficient ways of working.

jobs.title: 1.assistent til rengøringsteam SMP - Fyn
jobs.description:
Vi søger en erfaren 1.assistent til vores rengørings-team på Fyn.

Er du serviceminded og kan lide et job med meget kørsel?

SMP Rengøringsservice er i rivende udvikling og søger derfor en erfaren medarbejder på fuldtid (37t), til vores i forvejen stærke team på Fyn.

Som 1.assistent er dit ansvar at sikre afviklingen af den daglige rengøring i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

Andre opgaver kan også forekomme.

Du vil have direkte reference til din Serviceinspektør hos SMP rengøringsservice. Jobbet indebærer b.la. følgende arbejdsområder:

•   Skal stå for rengøring af egne pladser og øvrig bemanding iht. rengøringskalenderen

•   Skabe god relation til kunderne

•   Være behjælpelig med afløsning ved. ferie/sygdom

•   Hjælpe ved opstart af nye kunder og opgaver sammen med Serviceinspektør

•   Forefaldne opgaver i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

 

Det skal forventes, at timer kan ligge både tidlig morgen, eftermiddag og aften.

 

Hvem er du?

 

Vi søger dig, som trives i en omskiftelig hverdag, hvor opgaverne og dagene aldrig er ens.

Det er ikke vigtigt for dig, at du har faste rammer mandag-fredag fra 8-16, men tværtimod trives du med en flydende hverdag, hvor arbejdsugen kan variere med forskellige tidspunkter på dagen.

Som person kan du nikke genkendende til, at du:

•   Har erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

•   Trives i en til tider hektisk hverdag

•   Står til rådighed for rengøring af egne pladser

•   deler telefonvagt efter forudgående aftale

     står for sidemandsoplæring af rengøringspersonale

•   Kan håndtere og omgås forskellige kulturer

•   Behersker dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale på et rimeligt niveau

•   Har kørekort

•   Kan fremvise straffeattest

Du får stillet en firmabil til rådighed, samt firmatelefon- iPad, og arbejdsbeklædning.

Vi glæder os meget til at lære dig at kende - så hvis du kan se dig selv i denne stilling, bedes du sende din ansøgning til: job@smpservice.dk  - husk at mærke ansøgningen ” 1.assistent Fyn”

 

Samtaler bliver holdt løbende.

 

Har du ikke hørt fra os inden den 04.09.2026, skal du betragte jobbet som besat til anden side.

 

SMP er en velrenommeret virksomhed i rengøringsbranchen, - og det vil vi gerne blive ved med at være

Vi beskæftiger i dag mere end 300 medarbejdere med kunder i en stor del af Danmark. Vi har landsdækkende og lokale aftaler inden for kontor, produktion, skoler, slagterier, bagerier, butikker, supermarkeder mv.

 

SMP har lokale afdelinger både på Fyn, Jylland og Sjælland

jobs.title: Inspector, Private Home Cleaning  - Copenhagen
jobs.description:
RengøringsAgenterne ApS is looking for a dedicated inspector for our private home cleaning department

Do you have an eye for detail, and do you thrive in a role where quality and great customer relations go hand in hand? Then you might be our new inspector.

RengøringsAgenterne ApS is a Nordic Swan Ecolabel certified cleaning and property services company based in Kastrup. We have more than 200 employees, run a 100% electric vehicle fleet, and won the Børsen Gazelle award in both 2023 and 2024. We provide cleaning for housing associations, businesses and private customers across Greater Copenhagen – and it is our private customers you will be working with.

About the job

As inspector in our private cleaning department, you will be the link between our customers and our cleaning teams. You will report to the company's owner and managing director and play a central role in making sure quality is spot on every single time.

Your main tasks will be:

•      Quality control – ongoing inspection of completed cleaning in our private customers' homes

•      Quality reports – documentation and follow-up on inspection visits

•      Customer contact and relations – dialogue with customers, handling requests and feedback, and building long-term customer relationships

•      Operational support – hands-on support for the daily operations of the private cleaning department

Other tasks within the scope and responsibility of the position may also occur.

We expect that you

•      Have experience from the cleaning industry, the service industry or a similar role with quality responsibility

•      Have a sharp eye for detail and high standards for quality

•      Are outgoing and service-minded and enjoy daily customer contact

•      Communicate confidently in Danish, both spoken and written, including for reporting

•      Work in a structured and independent way and can plan your own day

•      Hold a category B driving licence, as the working day involves driving between customers

Experience with quality control or inspection work is an advantage, but not a requirement.

We offer

•      A full-time position of 40 hours per week with a fixed monthly salary

•      Employment as a salaried employee (funktionær) under proper terms – any overtime is compensated with time off in lieu at a 1:1 ratio

•      Health insurance paid by the company

•      A company car for work use by agreement, and work clothing where the position requires it

•      An informal and busy working day in a growing company with short decision-making paths

•      Green values in practice: Nordic Swan Ecolabel certification and an electric vehicle fleet

Practical information

•      Workplace: Fuglebækvej 3D, 2770 Kastrup – with daily driving to customers across Greater Copenhagen

•      Working hours: 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday between 8:00 and 17:00 (Friday until 16:30)

•      Start date: As soon as possible, or by agreement

How to apply

Send your application and CV via Jobnet or to privat@ren-agenterne.dk. We hold interviews on an ongoing basis and will hire as soon as we find the right candidate – so send your application today.

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to write to us at privat@ren-agenterne.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Procurement and Contracts Officer - Switzerland
jobs.description:
What you'll do:
As part of the Industry, Procurement and Knowledge Transfer (IPT) Department, you will join the Procurement and Industrial Services Group (PI), which is responsible for procuring all supplies and services for the Organization, ensuring that the specified and contractual technical, delivery and performance requirements are met at the lowest possible overall cost whilst achieving balanced industrial returns for CERN Member States and respecting CERN's Procurement Rules. The Group monitors and reports procurement activities and statistics to CERN Management and Member State representatives.

Your responsibilities:
- Advise and support the Organization in identifying procurement strategies, ensuring cost efficiency and quality.
- Carry out research to identify and participate in the qualification of potential suppliers.
- Prepare price enquiries, market surveys and invitations to tender in accordance with the Organization's Procurement Rules and on an international basis.
- Analyse offers, prepare proposals for adjudications and submit these to CERN's Management.
- Ensure the preparation, negotiation and follow-up of numerous orders and contracts.
- Contribute to the advancement of CERN's procurement techniques and tools, influencing their modernisation and optimisation.
- Foster and sustain a wide-ranging network of relationships across diverse levels, both internally and externally, while actively representing CERN in global business events.

Your profile:
- Demonstrated experience in procurement of technical supplies or services with a strong understanding of source-to-contract processes and procurement systems.
- Experience in setting category or procurement project-level strategies.
- Experience in executing plans in a matrix-driven decision-making process.
- Experience in collaborating with diverse teams and senior stakeholders.
- Experience in public procurement and contract management is desired.
- Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Economics, Purchasing, Law, Engineering, or a related field.

Your skills:
- Definition of tendering and contracting strategies.

jobs.title: Mid-Market Outcomes Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion

 - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the  opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals

 - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews

 - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion

 - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system

 - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 5+ years of experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working

 - Native level Japanese, business level English




NICE TO HAVES

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale

jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



About the role:

Join our FDE team and work directly with some of the world's largest organizations to turn their most ambitious ideas into production applications on Replit. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll partner closely with customers to understand their technical and business needs, architect solutions, and build the integrations and applications required to deploy Replit successfully within complex enterprise environments.

This is a deeply technical and hands-on role. You won’t just advise customers on what to build—you’ll build alongside them. You’ll take applications from initial idea and prototype through deployment and production, navigate complex enterprise environments, and solve the technical challenges that emerge when AI-powered software development meets real-world infrastructure, data, security, and organizational constraints.



You will:

 - Build with Customers: Embed with strategic enterprise customers to design and build high-impact applications and AI-powered workflows on Replit, taking projects from initial concept through production deployment.

 - Architect Enterprise Solutions: Design secure, scalable architectures that connect Replit with customers’ existing systems, data, APIs, identity providers, and infrastructure.

Preferred Qualifications
