jobs.title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
jobs.description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.description:

End-to-End Operations Management of 3PL Warehouse • Responsible for the daily end-to-end operations management of a single warehouse in Europe under the 3PL model, covering inbound, outbound, and inventory management; ensure inventory accuracy, inbound/outbound timeliness, and stable order fulfillment quality. • Coordinate the standardized execution and continuous optimization of core operational processes, including inbound quality inspection, put-away and storage, picking and packing, and outbound shipping. • Monitor daily/weekly/monthly operational data of 3PL service providers, promptly identify abnormalities, and drive corrective actions to closure. 3PL Service Provider Coordination and SLA Management • Serve as the key point of contact with 3PL service providers, responsible for daily operational communication, issue escalation, and relationship management. • Develop and drive the implementation of SLA metrics for 3PL service providers, including timeliness, accuracy, damage rate, and capacity flexibility; conduct regular reviews and performance evaluations. • Lead operational quality audits of 3PL providers, identify service gaps, and drive improvements in areas such as labor, equipment, and system integration. Process Optimization and Cost Efficiency Improvement • Continuously optimize operational efficiency, such as UPH, in core processes including inbound, packing, and sorting, to reduce per-unit handling costs. • Monitor warehouse capacity utilization and promote the implementation of storage strategies such as slow-moving inventory clearance and accurate replenishment/re-slotting to improve space efficiency. • Analyze cost drivers based on the 3PL pricing structure and drive cost-reduction initiatives, such as packaging optimization and route optimization. Labor and Productivity Management • Conduct workforce demand planning based on business forecasts and monitor deviations between actual attendance and planned staffing. • Address unexcused absenteeism, improve employee retention, analyze fluctuations in labor costs through data, and propose improvement plans. Inventory and Quality Control Management • Manage differentiated inbound processes for goods from multiple channels to ensure delivery quality and timeliness. • Responsible for storage planning and implementation of operational standards for different product categories, including general merchandise, bulky items, high-value goods, and shelf-life-sensitive products. • Drive closed-loop returns management, return-to-supplier optimization, and compliant labeling for special product categories. Cross-Functional Collaboration • Collaborate with Planning/S&OP, Logistics, Procurement, and other departments to ensure efficient coordination among business forecasting, workforce preparation, and fulfillment delivery. • Respond quickly to capacity bottlenecks by coordinating urgent recruitment or temporary resource allocation across warehouses.

jobs.title: Spanien Abonnemangssäljare
jobs.description:
Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare till kallkundsförsäljning till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 300 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.

jobs.title: Regional General Manager, France
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

You will lead Notion’s GTM strategy and growth for France, one of EMEA’s largest and highest-priority markets. France is a Tier 1 region in Notion’s country-first EMEA model, with significant room to scale into a standalone, high-growth business.

Notion is shifting from a traditional sales model toward a builder-led model with fewer handoffs, stronger technical fluency, and more direct ownership of customer outcomes. As General Manager, France, you will be the second-line leader responsible for overall revenue outcomes, regional GTM strategy, and the operating model for the French business. You will lead through frontline managers, teams of Business Development Representatives, Solutions Consultants and Outcomes Architects as well as partner cross functionally with Professional Services, Channel Partnerships and RevOps.

This is a hands-on builder-leader role for an AI-native, country-first GTM model. You will bring Notion’s new GTM model to life in France: moving from a segment-first motion to a country-first, AI-native operating system where teams help customers diagnose problems, design agentic workflows, and build real systems with Notion AI.

This role sits on the EMEA Leadership Team and reports to the General Manager, EMEA.

This role will be based in Paris. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the GTM strategy, operating rhythm, and growth plan for France, with accountability for overall regional revenue outcomes across Sales Assist and Self Serve contribution.

 - Lead as a second-line manager: hire, coach, and develop frontline leaders and IC teams across Business Development, Solutions Consulting, Outcomes Architecture, Forward Deployed Architecture/Engineering, and supporting GTM functions.

 - Scale a country-first GTM motion that brings Notion closer to French customers through local executive engagement, market nuance, and faster field-level decision-making.

 - Accelerate the land engine by opening the right front doors, growing professional workspaces, increasing net-new and upgrade opportunities, and connecting self-serve signals to sales-assisted motion.

 - Win lighthouse customers and turn them into market momentum by making them wildly successful, telling their story locally, and using those wins to influence peer companies across France.

 - Embed Notion’s AI-era GTM model across the team, including agent-enabled customer journeys, first-agent workflow activation, AI/agent demo proficiency, and stronger “build with the customer” motions.

 - Make agentic transformation central to the French GTM motion: help customers identify high-value workflows, build and deploy Notion Agents, automate cross-functional work, and measure outcomes from AI adoption.

 - Partner tightly with Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects/Engineers, Professional Services, Marketing and Channel to reduce handoffs and deliver faster, more durable customer value.

 - Build “sell with” partner motions in France, including partner-sourced pipeline, co-sell plays, enablement, AI/agentic solution packages, and joint account planning.

 - Establish Notion as a visible force in the French ecosystem through executive dinners, field events, startup and community engagement, partner activations, and customer advocacy.

 - Represent the voice of French customers back to Product, PMM, Marketing, and EMEA leadership, especially around AI transformation, enterprise requirements, security, compliance, localization, and competitive dynamics.

 - Create a talent destination in France by hiring builder-oriented leaders and ICs, raising the craft bar, and developing the next generation of AI-native GTM talent.

 - Drive operational excellence across forecasting, pipeline quality, territory planning, inspection cadence, performance management, and cross-functional execution.




WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR: 

A strategic and hands-on GTM operator who has scaled enterprise SaaS or AI businesses in France and knows how to build a market, not just inherit one. You have led through managers, owned complex revenue outcomes, and created local market momentum through customers, partners, community, and talent.

You combine second-line leadership with builder energy. You can set a crisp country strategy, install the operating system to execute it, and step into the field when needed — whether joining an executive customer conversation, sharpening a pipeline plan, coaching a manager, or helping the team translate a customer problem into an AI-powered, agentic workflow.

You are excited by Notion’s shift to an AI-native, country-first GTM model and believe the best GTM teams will increasingly be builders: BDRs who identify transformation opportunities, Solutions Consultants who build with customers in the room, Outcomes Architects who turn early workflows into durable adoption, and Forward Deployed Architects/Engineers who design the technical systems behind complex agentic workflows.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 12+ years of professional experience, including 5+ years leading SaaS or AI sales & GTM teams in France.

 - Deep knowledge of the French enterprise and startup ecosystem, including executive buyer networks, local partner channels, and market-specific buying dynamics across all market segments (commercial, midmarket and enterprise)

 - Proven second-line leadership experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing frontline managers and high-performing IC teams.

 - Track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets across new business, expansion, and renewal/churn dynamics.

 - Agency & Urgency: experience building or scaling a regional/country business in a high-growth or ambiguous environment.

 - Experience selling, implementing, or leading GTM teams around AI, automation, agentic workflows, collaboration, productivity, developer, or data products.

 - Strong strategic judgment: ability to define a country plan, segment the market, prioritize accounts and plays, and align cross-functional teams around outcomes.

 - Operational rigor across forecasting, pipeline generation, inspection, performance management, territory planning, and sales process.

 - Executive presence with CIO, CTO, CPO, COO, and business transformation buyers, with the ability to shape a compelling AI and agentic workflow narrative.

 - Strong understanding of modern GTM motions across Business Development, Solutions Consulting, Outcomes Architecture, Forward Deployed Architecture/Engineering, Professional Services, Channel, Marketing, RevOps, and Product.

 - Builder mentality and deep AI curiosity: comfortable learning, demoing, and coaching teams on agent-first workflows, proof-of-value motions, and customer co-building.

 - Fluency in French and English.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience launching or scaling a country-first or regional GTM operating model.

 - Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, APIs, webhooks, connectors, data residency, AI governance, and technical evaluation processes.

 - Experience scaling partner, channel, marketplace, or consultant-led GTM motions around AI or workflow transformation.

jobs.title: Senior RF Systems & Hardware Engineer – Coherent RF Architecture
jobs.description:
Description & Expectation

Quadsat is looking for an experienced RF Systems & Hardware Engineer to join the RF team working on SpectraLoc, our defense product for detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

This role will focus on RF front-end architecture, coherent receiver design, RF chain optimization, PCB design and layout, measurement integrity, and the continued productization of SpectraLoc. You will help strengthen the RF hardware foundation needed for robust product performance, certification readiness, and future next-generation RF architectures.

SpectraLoc combines RF sensing payloads, drone-based operations, mission control software, signal processing, geolocation algorithms, and operator-facing workflows into one integrated product. You will work closely with engineers spanning from RF, DSP, software, embedded, and FPGA specialist, with your primary focus being to improve RF system quality, hardware robustness, and the measurement integrity of the sensing chain.


Responsibilities:

Your main responsibility will be to develop, improve, and mature RF hardware and RF system architectures that support reliable RF sensing, geolocation, and future coherent receiver capabilities.

You will:

  • Design, develop, and optimize RF front-end architectures for RF sensing and geolocation applications.
  • Contribute to coherent receiver design, multi-channel RF architectures, and future direction-finding capabilities based on phase-coherent RF measurements.
  • Design and improve RF chains, including filtering, amplification, frequency conversion, gain distribution, dynamic range, noise figure, linearity, and sensitivity trade-offs.
  • Support PCB design and layout for RF circuits, including component selection, schematic design, layout review, signal integrity, grounding, shielding, and manufacturability.
  • Improve measurement integrity across the RF sensing chain by identifying and reducing sources of uncertainty, drift, phase error, loss, interference, leakage, and calibration sensitivity.
  • Plan and perform RF measurements, verification, and troubleshooting using relevant RF test equipment such as spectrum analysers, VNAs, signal generators, power meters, and related tools.
  • Work with DSP and software engineers to ensure that RF hardware behavior, calibration data, and system limitations are understood and properly reflected in algorithm development and product performance.
  • Support product robustness, certification readiness, and design-for-manufacturing activities by improving RF hardware quality, documentation, repeatability, and testability.
  • Provide technical leadership within RF systems and hardware, helping raise the quality of Quadsat’s RF design, validation methodology, and overall sensing performance.


Knowledge & Skills:

We envision that you have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, Microwave Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field, combined with strong practical experience in RF hardware development for RF sensing, SDR, radar, electronic warfare, SATCOM, aerospace, telecom, test and measurement, or other advanced RF systems.

More important than the exact degree is that you have hands-on experience designing, validating, and improving RF systems where measurement quality, robustness, and system performance matter.

In addition, you bring:

  • Strong practical experience with RF front-end design, RF chain architecture, and RF hardware development.
  • Experience with RF circuit design and PCB design/layout for high-frequency systems.
  • Solid understanding of RF system trade-offs, including gain, noise figure, dynamic range, linearity, filtering, frequency conversion, phase noise, spurious signals, leakage, and sensitivity.
  • Practical experience with RF measurement, verification, debugging, and calibration using professional RF test equipment.
  • Understanding of coherent RF systems, including phase stability, synchronization, channel matching, LO distribution, timing effects, and calibration considerations.
  • Familiarity with antenna interfaces, propagation effects, polarization, multipath, and how RF hardware behavior affects sensing and geolocation performance.
  • Ability to define test methods, performance metrics, acceptance criteria, and validation approaches for RF hardware and RF sensing systems.
  • Experience collaborating with DSP, software, embedded, FPGA, mechanical, robotics, and product teams to turn RF hardware concepts into robust product capabilities.
  • A proactive mindset, strong ownership, and the ability to work independently while staying aligned with broader product and engineering priorities.

It would be highly advantageous if you also have experience with electronic warfare, radar systems, SIGINT, RF surveillance, phased arrays, coherent multi-channel receivers, interferometry, monopulse tracking, beamforming, calibration of RF sensing systems, MIL-STD certification, environmental robustness, SDR platforms, or transitioning RF hardware from prototype into production.


Our Dynamic Work Environment:

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, high-quality engineering, and people who want their work to matter beyond the codebase.


Contact:

For recruitment related questions contact Human Resources Director, AislinnCampbell, by mail at afc@quadsat.com or by phone at +45 71 74 97 81.

jobs.title: DSP Engineer - RF Sensing & Geolocation
jobs.description:
Description & Expectation

Quadsat is looking for an experienced Digital Signal Processing Engineer to join the RF team working on SpectraLoc, our defense product for detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

This role will predominantly involve designing and implementing DSP algorithms for signal classification, interference detection, signal deinterleaving, and geo-localisation within Software Defined Radio (SDR) systems.

SpectraLoc combines RF sensing payloads, drone-based operations, mission control software, signal processing, geolocation algorithms, and operator-facing workflows into one integrated product. You will work closely with RF, software, embedded, FPGA, and product teams, with your primary focus being to develop and validate DSP algorithms that improve sensing performance, robustness, and product quality across defense use cases.


Responsibilities:

Your main responsibility will be to develop, validate, and mature DSP algorithms that improve the performance, robustness, and quality of Quadsat’s RF sensing and geolocation capabilities.

  • Design, prototype, and validate DSP algorithms for RF signal classification, interference detection, demodulation, signal analysis, and geo-localization within Software Defined Radio (SDR) systems.
  • Develop algorithm concepts, reference implementations, and validation tools in Python, MATLAB, or similar technical computing environments.
  • Work with recorded and live RF data to evaluate algorithm performance, identify limitations, and improve robustness under real-world conditions such as noise, interference, multipath, calibration errors, and synchronization effects.
  • Contribute to direction finding and RF sensing capabilities, including methods such as AoA, TDOA, interferometry, monopulse processing, beamforming, tracking, and related estimation techniques.
  • Define test methods, performance metrics, and acceptance criteria for DSP algorithms, including accuracy, sensitivity, stability, robustness, and failure modes.
  • Collaborate with software, embedded, FPGA, and RF engineers to support the transition of validated algorithms into product-ready implementations.
  • Provide technical leadership within DSP and RF sensing, helping raise the quality of Quadsat’s algorithm development, validation methodology, and overall sensing performance.


Knowledge & Skills:

We envision that you have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Signal Processing, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical field, combined with strong practical experience in DSP development for RF, SDR, radar, electronic warfare, SATCOM, aerospace, telecom, or other advanced sensing systems.

More important than the exact degree is that you have hands-on experience developing and validating DSP algorithms on real RF data.

In addition, you bring:

  • Strong practical experience with digital signal processing for RF and Software Defined Radio systems.
  • Proven ability to develop, prototype, and validate DSP algorithms in Python, MATLAB, or similar technical computing environments.
  • Experience working with real RF measurement data, including noisy or imperfect data from SDRs, radar, EW, SATCOM, telecom, or related systems.
  • Solid understanding of RF signal chains, including sampling, bandwidth, filtering, SNR, synchronization, phase, and calibration effects.
  • Experience with signal detection, classification, interference analysis, signal characterization, or geolocation-related signal processing.
  • Experience with direction finding or RF sensing techniques such as AoA, TDOA, interferometry, monopulse processing, beamforming, triangulation, tracking, or related estimation methods.
  • Ability to define validation methods, performance metrics, test cases, and acceptance criteria for DSP algorithms.
  • Familiarity with SDR platforms and practical deployment constraints such as real-time processing, data throughput, latency, synchronization, and hardware limitations.
  • A proactive mindset, strong ownership, and the ability to work independently while collaborating closely with RF, software, embedded, FPGA, robotics, and product teams.

It would be highly advantageous if you also have experience with electronic warfare, radar development, SIGINT, RF surveillance, coherent multi-channel RF systems, C/C++ implementation, FPGA-based DSP, embedded DSP, fixed-point processing, CUDA, VHDL, Verilog, calibration, or transitioning algorithms from prototype into operational products.


Our Dynamic Work Environment:

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, high-quality engineering, and people who want their work to matter beyond the codebase.


Contact:

For role or recruitment related questions contact Human Resources Director, AislinnCampbell, by mail at afc@quadsat.com or by phone at +45 71 74 97 81.

jobs.title: Klargøringsmedarbejder søges til vores afdeling i Hillerød
jobs.description:
Sætter du en ære i at levere et solidt stykke arbejde? Og kan du holde overblik og yde kundeservice på højt niveau i en travl hverdag? Så er du måske vores nye klargøringsmedarbejder.

Om jobbet

Som klargøringsmedarbejder i Hillerød bliver du en del af en afdeling med høj faglighed og stor erfaring i udlejningsbranchen. Dine primære opgaver bliver at holde pladsen indbydende, sørge for at sikkerheden er i top samt klargøre materiel til udlejning. Du kommer også til at hjælpe med personlig og telefonisk servicering af kunderne, ligesom du vil møde kunderne, når du leverer og afhenter materiel med firehjulstrækker.

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring fra maskinbranchen med klargøring, vedligeholdelse og reparation af små og store entreprenørmaskiner. Det er en forudsætning, at du har kørekort, og det er en fordel, hvis du også har BE-kort samt truckcertifikat. Derudover er det nødvendigt, at du har kendskab til PC på brugerniveau, da der forekommer arbejdsopgaver på computer.

Som person er du selvstændig og imødekommende, og du vægter både sikkerhed og kundeservice højt. Du trives i et til tider hektisk miljø og er god til at holde overblikket. Vi lægger desuden stor vægt på, at du er en positiv og hjælpsom kollega, som giver en hånd med, hvor der er behov for det.

Vi tilbyder

  • Et spændende job og en varierende hverdag

  • Gode muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling

  • En arbejdsplads med en humoristisk og uformel kultur samt et højt fagligt niveau

  • Konkurrencedygtig løn efter kvalifikationer

Interesseret?

Synes du, at stillingen lyder interessant, og kan du se dig selv som en del af holdet i Hillerød? Send hurtigst muligt ansøgning og CV til job@nordjysklift.dk mærket med ”klargøringsmedarbejder Hillerød” i emnefeltet.

Vi ønsker stillingen besat snarest og holder samtaler løbende. Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Sigurd Hultgren 30 85 85 85.

Nordjysk Lift er en af landets førende udlejningsvirksomheder inden for materiel. Vi er omkring 130 medarbejdere, der hver dag arbejder benhårdt for at blive kundernes foretrukne valg, når de har brug for materiel. Vi sætter en ære i den nære relation med kunderne. Derfor har vi hele 11 afdelinger fordelt rundt i Danmark, så vi også i den fysiske forstand er tæt på kunderne.

jobs.title: Senior auto mechanic / technician
jobs.description:
Are you a trained mechanic, and are you motivated by technology, quality and good colleagues? Would you like to become part of a modern, fully electric vehicle workshop where professional development, teamwork and fleet operational stability are the focus? Then you might be the person we're looking for at our workshop at GreenMobility in Rødovre!

Professionalism, quality and development

At GreenMobility, we are looking for a skilled senior technician/automechanic who, together with the rest of the workshop team, will ensure high quality in the daily work and contribute to the best possible operational stability for our fleet of 1,400 electric cars in Copenhagen.

You will become part of a professional workshop where we work exclusively with electric vehicles, modern technology and ongoing skills development. If you are earlier in your career, we will provide thorough training and sparring from experienced colleagues.

Your primary tasks will include:

  • Maintenance and repair of passenger cars (fully electric), including motors, gearboxes, brakes, suspension and coupling systems

  • Fault-finding and diagnosis of error codes using OEM and third-party diagnostic tools

  • Identifying and repairing faults on electric motors

  • Servicing and repairing AC pumps and climate systems

  • Carrying out routine inspections and preventive maintenance to minimise fleet downtime

  • Accurate documentation of all repairs, parts used and diagnostic results in the workshop system

We imagine that you:

  • Are a trained passenger car mechanic or have an equivalent technical background

  • Work independently, in a structured and quality-conscious manner

  • Have an interest in new technology, modern vehicle systems and electric cars

  • Are a team player who contributes positively to collaboration in the workshop

  • Focus on delivering high quality and doing the job right the first time

  • Hold a category B driving licence

  • Have English skills sufficient for technical documentation and team communication

  • Are comfortable using digital tools to document repairs across the fleet

Experience with our vehicle brands (Renault, Kia, Nissan...) is an advantage, but not a requirement. What matters most is your professional curiosity and desire to develop.

Your new workplace

GreenMobility is the largest free-floating car-sharing operator in the Nordics. With a fleet of 1,600 electric cars, we contribute to greener and cleaner mobility in Aarhus and Copenhagen. Every month we enable more than 185,000 shared car trips, reducing car ownership and making cities more liveable places.

We offer

  • To be part of a green mission you can be proud of

  • An exciting everyday working life in a modern workshop

  • Ongoing training and good development opportunities

  • A strong professional and international working environment with skilled colleagues

  • Attractive terms of employment

  • A workplace focused on wellbeing, collaboration and integrity

Would you like to join the team? We look forward to receiving your application.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and will hire once we have found the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible.

If you have questions about the position, you are very welcome to contact Fanny Dutrey on +45 31 27 21 30 or fd@greenmobility.com

We look forward to hearing from you!

GreenMobility A/S

Den perfekta kandidaten

Vi söker dig som är social, nyfiken och tycker om att skapa nya relationer. Du kommunicerar professionellt på svenska och trivs med att prata med företagskunder.

Erfarenhet av mötesbokning, försäljning eller kundkontakt är meriterande, men inget krav. Det viktigaste är din inställning, din vilja att utvecklas och din förmåga att skapa förtroende i samtal med svenska företag.

    Skapa dialog med beslutsfattare och identifiera relevanta affärsbehov

    Bidra till teamets gemensamma mål och resultat
    Utveckla dina kunskaper inom kommunikation, försäljning och affärsförståelse

    Flytande svenska i tal och skrift
    God kommunikativ förmåga och lätt för att skapa relationer
    Intresse för B2B-kommunikation och professionell kundkontakt
    Positiv inställning och vilja att lära dig nya färdigheter
    Förmåga att arbeta strukturerat och målinriktat
    Erfarenhet inom mötesbokning, försäljning eller kundservice är meriterande men inget krav

Lön och förmåner

    Fast lön med attraktiv bonusmodell
    Fast anställning på kontoret i Málaga
    Grundlig introduktion och utbildning inom alla projekt
    Möjlighet att arbeta med flera olika branscher och målgrupper
    Ett starkt svenskt team med god sammanhållning
    Löpande utvecklingsmöjligheter inom försäljning och rådgivning
    En arbetsmiljö där kvalitet prioriteras framför kvantitet

Vad får du ut av att arbeta hos oss?

    Möjlighet att utveckla dina färdigheter inom försäljning, rådgivning och affärsutveckling
    Inblick i spännande branscher som HR, IT, fintech och företagslösningar

jobs.title: AEO/GEO/SEO Lead
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Search is being rebuilt in real time. Millions of people now start with a question to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Perplexity, and the answer they get decides which products they try. When someone asks how to build an app, a website, or a tool for their business, Replit needs to be the answer.

We're hiring an AEO/GEO/SEO Lead to own how Replit gets discovered, across AI-generated answers and traditional search. This is a zero-to-one role. You'll define the strategy, then execute it yourself with AI-leveraged production, agency partners, and cross-functional teams behind you. You'll work daily with our Web, Growth, Brand, Content, Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams.

The fastest-growing AI-native companies have already turned AI answers into a primary acquisition channel. Your mandate is to do the same for Replit: grow AI referral traffic into one of our largest sources of new builders, keep our traditional search presence compounding, and make Replit the platform AI assistants recommend when anyone wants to build software.

Replit moves fast. We ship continuously, experiment relentlessly, and aim to make every builder more productive and creative. We're looking for someone who thrives in that environment: part strategist, part operator, part scientist of a channel that changes every month.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the AEO/GEO Strategy Define where Replit must show up across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, for which prompts and buyer intents, and build the playbook to win those answers. Set targets, sequence the roadmap, and defend the strategy with data.

 - Win Citations Across the Open Web LLMs cite what they trust: Reddit threads, YouTube videos, high-authority publications, community content, and well-structured owned pages. Build durable programs on each of these surfaces, understand the half-life of an AI citation, and keep Replit ranked as models retrain and retrieval systems shift.

 - Run SEO End to End Own keyword strategy, on-page optimization, technical SEO, and content-driven organic growth in partnership with our Head of Web. Protect and grow search equity through a major site relaunch, and coordinate with our paid search team on keyword coverage.

 - Build the Content Engine Produce and direct content designed for two readers at once: LLM crawlers and humans. Blogs, comparison pages, videos, and structured resources, created at volume with AI-assisted workflows and held to a high quality bar. The durable human work here is judgment: strategy, editorial quality, and distribution.

 - Stand Up Measurement Build reporting for a channel that lacks perfect attribution: AI referral traffic, share of voice in AI answers, citation tracking, and downstream signups and revenue. Run controlled experiments, isolate what actually moves citations, and teach the rest of the company what you learn.

 - Direct Agencies and Tools Own our agency and vendor relationships across search and AI visibility, plus the tool stack that powers tracking and production. Write the briefs, hold the quality bar, and decide what stays in-house.
   



YOU'LL BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU:

 - Have 5+ years in SEO, organic growth, or content-driven acquisition (ideally within SaaS, technology, or developer-focused businesses), including hands-on AEO/GEO work within the last year

 - Can show real results: AI referral traffic you grew, citations you won, rankings you moved, and how you measured all of it

 - Are technically fluent in SEO: keyword research, crawling, indexing, structured data, site architecture, and log analysis

 - Understand how LLMs actually retrieve and cite sources, and how that differs across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity

 - Write clearly and quickly, and can direct people, agencies, and AI tools to produce content that earns citations

 - Are analytical enough to build credible measurement in a messy, fast-changing channel, connecting organic visibility to traffic, signups, product adoption, and revenue

 - Are comfortable partnering with engineering, product, content, and analytics stakeholders to get changes shipped in a fast-moving environment

 - Love building from scratch: frameworks, processes, and strategy

 - Have a founder mindset: you identify gaps and fill them, move quickly, and don't wait for someone else to define the playbook

 - A collaborative, low-ego approach and willingness to dig into the details
   



BONUS POINTS:

 - Made AI answers a primary acquisition channel at a PLG, consumer, or developer-facing software company

 - Deep Reddit fluency: you understand how communities work and how to earn credible presence there

 - Experience running YouTube as an organic discovery channel

 - Hands-on with AI visibility and citation tracking tools (Profound, Peec, Ahrefs Brand Radar, or similar)

 - Programmatic SEO at meaningful scale

 - You've built with Replit or other AI building tools and understand our builders firsthand

 - Experience directing SEO/AEO agencies and fractional specialists

jobs.title: Regional General Manager, DACH
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




WHO WE ARE:

This role sits on the EMEA Leadership Team and reports to the General Manager, EMEA.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the GTM strategy, operating rhythm, and growth plan for Germany, with accountability for overall regional revenue outcomes across Sales Assist and Self Serve contribution.

 - Lead as a second-line manager: hire, coach, and develop frontline leaders and IC teams across Business Development, Solutions Consulting, Outcomes Architecture, Forward Deployed Architecture/Engineering, and supporting GTM functions.

 - Scale a country-first GTM motion that brings Notion closer to German customers through local executive engagement, market nuance, and faster field-level decision-making.

 - Accelerate the land engine by opening the right front doors, growing professional workspaces, increasing net-new and upgrade opportunities, and connecting self-serve signals to sales-assisted motion.

 - Win lighthouse customers and turn them into market momentum by making them wildly successful, telling their story locally, and using those wins to influence peer companies across Germany.

 - Embed Notion’s AI-era GTM model across the team, including agent-enabled customer journeys, first-agent workflow activation, AI/agent demo proficiency, and stronger “build with the customer” motions.

 - Make agentic transformation central to the German GTM motion: help customers identify high-value workflows, build and deploy Notion Agents, automate cross-functional work, and measure outcomes from AI adoption.

 - Partner tightly with Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects/Engineers, Professional Services, and Channel to reduce handoffs and deliver faster, more durable customer value.

 - Build “sell with” partner motions in Germany, including partner-sourced pipeline, co-sell plays, enablement, AI/agentic solution packages, and joint account planning.

 - Establish Notion as a visible force in the German ecosystem through executive dinners, field events, startup and community engagement, partner activations, and customer advocacy.

 - Represent the voice of German customers back to Product, PMM, Marketing, and EMEA leadership, especially around AI transformation, enterprise requirements, security, compliance, localization, and competitive dynamics.

 - Create a talent destination in Germany by hiring builder-oriented leaders and ICs, raising the craft bar, and developing the next generation of AI-native GTM talent.

 - Drive operational excellence across forecasting, pipeline quality, territory planning, inspection cadence, performance management, and cross-functional execution.
   
   


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR: 

A strategic and hands-on GTM operator who has scaled enterprise SaaS or AI businesses in Germany and knows how to build a market, not just inherit one. You have led through managers, owned complex revenue outcomes, and created local market momentum through customers, partners, community, and talent.

You combine second-line leadership with builder energy. You can set a crisp country strategy, install the operating system to execute it, and step into the field when needed — whether joining an executive customer conversation, sharpening a pipeline plan, coaching a manager, or helping the team translate a customer problem into an AI-powered, agentic workflow.

You are excited by Notion’s shift to an AI-native, country-first GTM model and believe the best GTM teams will increasingly be builders: BDRs who identify transformation opportunities, Solutions Consultants who build with customers in the room, Outcomes Architects who turn early workflows into durable adoption, and Forward Deployed Architects/Engineers who design the technical systems behind complex agentic workflows.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 12+ years of professional experience, including 5+ years SaaS or AI sales & GTM teams in Germany.

 - Proven second-line leadership experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing frontline managers and high-performing IC teams.

 - Track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets across new business, expansion, and renewal/churn dynamics.

 - Deep knowledge of the German enterprise and startup ecosystem, including executive buyer networks, local partner channels, and market-specific buying dynamics.

 - Experience building or scaling a regional/country business in a high-growth or ambiguous environment.

 - Experience selling, implementing, or leading GTM teams around AI, automation, agentic workflows, collaboration, productivity, developer, or data products.

 - Strong strategic judgment: ability to define a country plan, segment the market, prioritize accounts and plays, and align cross-functional teams around outcomes.

 - Operational rigor across forecasting, pipeline generation, inspection, performance management, territory planning, and sales process.

 - Executive presence with CIO, CTO, CPO, COO, and business transformation buyers, with the ability to shape a compelling AI and agentic workflow narrative.

 - Strong understanding of modern GTM motions across Business Development, Solutions Consulting, Outcomes Architecture, Forward Deployed Architecture/Engineering, Professional Services, Channel, Marketing, RevOps, and Product.

 - Builder mentality and deep AI curiosity: comfortable learning, demoing, and coaching teams on agent-first workflows, proof-of-value motions, and customer co-building.

 - Fluency in German and English.
   
   


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience launching or scaling a country-first or regional GTM operating model.

 - Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, APIs, webhooks, connectors, data residency, AI governance, and technical evaluation processes.

 - Experience scaling partner, channel, marketplace, or consultant-led GTM motions around AI or workflow transformation.

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and target companies that are ready to rethink how they work—and your job is to get them in the room. This isn't generic pipeline work: you're qualifying for workflow-first, build-ready opportunities that set SCs up to win. If you're competitive, curious, and energized by outbound that actually means something, this is the role for you.

 

This role is based in Dublin, Ireland. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Generate qualified, workflow-first pipeline by identifying and targeting high-potential accounts in your assigned book, partnering with your sellers on account and outbound strategy

 - Run multi-channel outbound campaigns—email, phone, LinkedIn, and events—to create urgency and secure first meetings with the right decision-makers

 - Conduct initial qualification to ensure meetings handed to sellers are "ready to build," not just "ready to talk"—validating ICP, intent, and workflow fit before the handoff

 - Document and deliver clean handoff packets in Salesforce with ICP signals, pain points, workflow hypothesis, and stakeholder context so sellers can hit the ground running

 - Leverage GTM System tooling and intent data to sharpen targeting, prioritize accounts by signal strength, and increase the quality and consistency of your outbound motion

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Proven track record in outbound pipeline generation, with hands-on experience in cold prospecting across phone, email, and social channels

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to craft compelling, persona-specific outreach that earns a response

 - Sharp qualification instincts—able to quickly assess ICP fit, identify urgency, and set solutions consultants up for high-quality first conversations

 - Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models

 - High-activity mindset with the discipline to prioritize based on signal and data, not just volume

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Fluency in Dutch

 


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, or similar GTM tooling

 - Familiarity with Notion as a product or prior experience selling productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Background in a high-velocity, metric-driven outbound environment with clear pipeline targets
   
   
   
    

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €70,000 OTE per year.

jobs.description:
Are you a talented Senior Developer looking for a remote job that lets you show your skills and get decent compensation? Look no further than Lemon.io — the marketplace that connects you with hand-picked startups in the US and Europe.

jobs.title: Customer Support Associate with Norwegian & English – Sofia, Bulgaria
jobs.description:
For more than 37 years, Sutherland has been a global leader in Customer Experience Management (CXM). As a pioneer in automation and innovative customer solutions, we deliver exceptional service on behalf of our clients worldwide.

With operations in 60 countries and a presence in Bulgaria since 2008, our diverse team of more than 2,000 professionals supports customers in 17 different languages from Sofia, Varna, Burgas, and remote locations.

🎯 About the Role

We are looking for a Customer Support Associate with Danish and English to join our team supporting customers of a leading international telecommunications provider.

You will assist customers through inbound voice and non-voice channels, including phone, email, and chat, with day-to-day service-related questions such as top-ups, SIM activation, roaming usage, and general account inquiries. This is a pure customer service role with no sales, upselling, or device troubleshooting.

Key Responsibilities

    Handle inbound customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and other supported channels
    Assist customers with top-ups, SIM activation, roaming usage, and general service-related questions
    Resolve customer concerns efficiently and aim for first-contact resolution whenever possible
    Accurately document customer interactions and follow established processes
    Provide professional, clear, and empathetic support in every interaction

🧠 What We’re Looking For

Must-have:

    Norwegian – minimum B2 level
    English – minimum B2 level
    Undergraduate, graduate, postgraduate education or equivalent
    Strong verbal and written communication skills
    Good computer skills and ability to work with multiple systems
    Availability to work 09:00–18:00, Monday to Friday

Nice-to-have:

    Previous experience in customer service, BPO, telecommunications, or a similar environment
    Experience working with CRM or ticketing systems
    Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-focused mindset

🎁 What You’ll Get

Compensation & Benefits:

    Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
    Additional health insurance
    Food vouchers
    3 weeks of paid training in English, followed by accreditation
    Relocation support to Sofia for eligible candidates

Work Environment:

    Onsite from our Sofia office
    Working hours: 09:00–18:00, Monday to Friday
    Voice and non-voice customer support

Growth & Development

You will receive structured training and ongoing support while developing your customer service and communication skills in an international environment.

🚀 Ready to Apply?

Join us and become part of a team that delivers exceptional customer experiences every day. Apply now and start your journey with Sutherland.

jobs.title: Senior Product Compliance Coordinator - Malta
jobs.description:
Come and join our journey!

At Immense Group, we are guided by our core values of passion, boldness, and integrity. We strive to create an environment where our people thrive, driven by a love for innovation and a commitment to delivering exceptional player experiences. If you’re passionate about compliance and Product Operations, bold in your approach, and act with integrity, we’d love for you to join our team as a Senior Product Compliance Coordinator.

A taste of what you’ll do

The Senior Product Compliance Coordinator is responsible for leading the operational compliance function within Product Operations, ensuring all games and operational activities comply with regulatory requirements across all brands and jurisdictions.

The role combines regulatory compliance with process governance, documentation, audit readiness, and continuous improvement while working closely with Product Operations, Legal & Compliance, DEVS, Projects, Partnership Management, and external providers.

A key responsibility of the role is ensuring compliance processes, certifications, regulatory documentation, and operational controls remain accurate, audit-ready, and continuously improved to support operational consistency, regulatory compliance, and business growth.

Regulatory Compliance & Operational Governance

    Lead the certification lifecycle, ensuring game certifications, re-certifications, and market-specific regulatory documentation remain accurate and up to date.
    Ensure games, promotions, configurations, and operational activities comply with jurisdictional and regulatory requirements before release.
    Coordinate regulatory documentation with Compliance, DEVS, Projects, testing laboratories, and game providers.
    Maintain certification repositories, compliance trackers, regulatory evidence, and audit documentation.
    Monitor regulatory changes and coordinate operational implementation across Product Operations.
    Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation, coordinating evidence, and following up on audit actions.
    Create, maintain, and continuously improve compliance procedures, SOPs, checklists, and regulatory documentation.
    Ensure compliance documentation remains accurate, current, and aligned with regulatory requirements and operational workflows.
    Support the development of compliance-related Knowledge Base articles and onboarding material.
    Promote standardisation of compliance processes across Product Operations.
    Prepare compliance reports, certification trackers, regulatory dashboards, and market-specific reporting.
    Identify compliance risks, operational gaps, and opportunities to strengthen operational controls.
    Support implementation of automation initiatives and AI-assisted tools that improve compliance processes, documentation, and reporting.
    Work closely with Product Operations, Legal & Compliance, DEVS, CRM, Customer Operations, Projects, and external providers to maintain regulatory alignment.
    Participate in operational, regulatory, and cross-functional projects as required.
    Support new market launches and regulatory initiatives.
    Maintain sufficient operational knowledge to provide support across Product Operations where required and contribute to business continuity.
    Perform any other task or responsibility related or connected to the role.

Additional Responsibilities

    Reporting, Improvement & Coordination
    Audit Readiness & Compliance Documentation

Who and what we are after?

    Minimum of 3 years’ experience within the iGaming industry in Compliance, Product Operations, Certification Management, QA, or a similar operational role.
    Demonstrated experience managing regulatory documentation, certifications, audits, or compliance-related processes.
    Good understanding of casino games, game certifications, regulated markets, and operational compliance requirements.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify compliance risks and recommend practical solutions.
    Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
    Experience developing or maintaining compliance documentation, SOPs, checklists, and regulatory procedures.
    Experience supporting or leading process improvement and operational governance initiatives.
    Comfortable working with compliance reports, certification trackers, regulatory dashboards, and operational metrics.
    An interest in automation and AI-assisted operational processes.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
    Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively across multiple teams.
    Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and regulated environment.
    Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and operational discipline.
    Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team while also working independently and taking ownership of allocated responsibilities.

Employee benefits

    Private health insurance – because your wellbeing matters to us
    Wellness allowance – up to €300 per year
    Fresh and healthy breakfast and lunch prepared every day in our penthouse kitchen – you can save up to €3,000 a year
    Birthday leave – as we want you to celebrate your day
    Company and team-building events – trust us, these are legendary
    Relocation package to Malta, including a flight and two weeks of accommodation
    And much more – see for yourself!

Apply today and be part of our success story!

jobs.title: Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B) - Malta
jobs.description:
Come and join our journey!

A taste of what you’ll do

As a Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B), you will serve as a primary legal and compliance contact for business-to-business affairs, supporting a broad range of contractual, regulatory, and gambling compliance responsibilities across multiple jurisdictions.

Accountabilities:

    Act as a primary legal partner for B2B affairs, leading day-to-day contractual reviews, negotiations, and drafting of a broad range of commercial agreements and related documentation.
    Lead the preparation, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts using and refining standard templates, including platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Provide clear, commercially focused legal advice to management, presenting legal risks, practical options, and strategic recommendations to support informed decision-making.
    Collaborate cross-functionally with the broader Group legal and compliance function to support business objectives.
    Manage the preparation, submission, and ongoing maintenance of gaming licence applications across multiple jurisdictions, taking ownership of assigned portfolios.
    Verify that prospective and existing B2B clients hold valid gambling licences or authorisations in each market in which products or services will be deployed, and monitor counterparty licence status, regulatory standing, and market exits throughout the relationship lifecycle.
    Maintain the approved-markets framework, advising on market permissibility and regulated versus unregulated market positioning, and ensuring territory and geo-restriction requirements are reflected in commercial agreements.
    Support proactive and collaborative relationships with regulatory authorities, as needed.
    Manage ongoing licence maintenance obligations across the B2B licence portfolio, including key event reporting, regulatory notifications, periodic returns, and compliance and system audits.
    Act as holder of key functions and/or personal management licences, as applicable, across relevant jurisdictions, subject to regulatory approval and applicable vetting requirements.
    Monitor regulatory developments affecting B2B supply, assessing the impact of new and emerging supplier licensing regimes and feeding outcomes into market entry, certification, and licensing strategies.
    Create, update, implement, monitor, and enforce policies, procedures, guidelines, and manuals.
    Oversee technical compliance requirements, including managing relationships with accredited test laboratories, owning the certification and homologation roadmap for each jurisdiction, and coordinating security audits and product certification.
    Manage regulatory change-management processes for game and platform releases, coordinating with product and technical teams on certification, notification, and remediation requirements.
    Ensure content and brand protection by registration, maintenance, and renewal of intellectual property rights by assisting in any IP disputes that may arise from time to time, and developing and implementing a domain name strategy.
    Own the B2B counterparty onboarding and due diligence framework, including Know Your Business (KYB) and Customer Due Diligence (CDD) on prospective clients and suppliers, sanctions and adverse media screening, and anti-bribery and corruption due diligence on commercial partners and intermediaries.
    Advise on data protection matters arising in B2B arrangements, including controller–processor analysis, negotiation of data processing agreements, and international data transfer requirements, in coordination with the Group’s data protection function.
    Perform other job-related functions as assigned.

Qualifications

    Qualified lawyer with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law (LLB or equivalent).

Required Skills

    1–3 years’ post-qualification experience in regulatory, legal, or advisory roles, within B2B iGaming.
    Demonstrated experience in multi-jurisdictional gambling regulation and licensing, including the preparation and management of licence applications and regulatory submissions.
    Demonstrated experience drafting and negotiating B2B commercial agreements, such as platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Familiarity with B2B/supplier licensing and authorisation regimes, as distinct from operator licensing, and with technical compliance and certification frameworks, including working with accredited test laboratories.
    Eligibility and willingness to undergo regulatory vetting and to hold key function or personal management licence appointments, as required; prior experience holding such appointments is advantageous.
    Experience providing independent regulatory advice to internal business stakeholders.
    Working knowledge of data protection requirements in a B2B contracting context, including data processing agreements and international transfers.
    Exposure to intellectual property portfolio management, brand protection, or counterparty due diligence (KYB/CDD, sanctions screening) is advantageous.

Preferred Skills

    Strong legal research, analysis, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address regulatory issues independently.
    Sound commercial drafting and negotiation skills across a broad range of B2B agreement types.
    Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements and translate them into clear, practical, and commercially sound advice.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present regulatory analysis to non-legal audiences.
    Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage a varied and demanding workload, prioritise effectively, and meet deadlines.
    High level of professionalism, integrity, and attention to detail.
    Fluency in English is required; proficiency in an additional language is advantageous.

Employee benefits

    Private health insurance – because your wellbeing matters
    Wellness allowance – up to €300 per year
    Fresh and healthy breakfast & lunch prepared daily in our penthouse kitchen
    Birthday leave – celebrate your day your way
    Company and team-building events – and yes, they’re legendary
    Relocation package to Malta (if applicable)
    Many onsite activities - weekly yoga class, occasional massage sessions, happy hours each month etc.
    And much more – come see for yourself

Meet the criteria? Apply today and become part of the Immense Group journey.

jobs.title: Vice President, Technology & Digital Strategy
jobs.description:
About ShatterproofShatterproof is a national nonprofit working toward a world where addiction never defines or ends a life. Through evidence-based programs, advocacy, and public education, Shatterproof works to transform systems for tomorrow, support families today, and end stigma forever. Learn more at shatterproof.org.

Who Succeeds at Shatterproof
Shatterproof is in a period of transformative and rapid growth. We are building new systems, reimagining how work gets done, and creating more cross-functional alignment to accelerate our mission.
To thrive here, you should be energized by building, not just maintaining, and excited to bring structure, clarity, and innovation to evolving spaces.
We're looking for team members who:

  • Build systems and processes from the ground up and improve them continuously as we scale.
  • Take ownership and act with a builder's mindset, bringing forward solutions rather than waiting for direction.
  • Influence and collaborate across teams, shaping work through strong communication and relationship-building.
  • Move quickly, learn fast, and adapt with resilience, especially in a high-growth, high-impact environment.
  • Are mission-driven and motivated to leave their mark on an organization working to reverse the addiction crisis.

The RoleReporting to the Chief Financial & Administrative Officer, the Vice President, Technology & Digital Strategy serves as Shatterproof's senior technology executive and leads the organization's technology, digital operations, cybersecurity, data, artificial intelligence, enterprise applications, digital platforms, and technology-enabled products.
This leader will create and execute a comprehensive technology vision that advances organizational strategy, enables operational excellence, strengthens security and resilience, improves the employee experience, supports fundraising and advocacy, and drives innovation across mission-focused platforms.
This role is ideal for a builder who wants the rare opportunity to shape not only an organization's technology strategy, but also how technology, data, AI, and digital platforms accelerate mission impact at scale.

The Team

The Vice President leads a multidisciplinary team spanning enterprise technology, digital operations, data, and product management. Current direct reports and functional oversight areas include IT Operations, Digital Operations, enterprise CRM and database capabilities, Treatment Atlas Product Management, and Treatment Atlas Data Management. The role is responsible for developing these capabilities into a cohesive, high-performing technology function that provides exceptional organizational support while advancing Shatterproof's digital, data, and platform strategy.

The team supports and manages a broad portfolio that includes enterprise technology and workplace operations, cybersecurity and privacy, Salesforce and enterprise applications, website and fundraising technology, business intelligence and reporting, artificial intelligence initiatives, and the current and future technology architecture supporting Treatment Atlas.

In addition to leading the internal team, the Vice President oversees a network of managed service providers, software vendors, implementation partners, and technology consultants, ensuring that internal and external resources are aligned to organizational priorities and positioned to scale with Shatterproof's evolving needs. This includes stewardship of strategic technology platforms and vendor relationships that support operations, fundraising, advocacy, data management, and mission delivery. Key ResponsibilitiesEnterprise Technology Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and execute a multi-year enterprise technology strategy aligned with organizational priorities.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on technology investments, risks, innovation opportunities, and emerging trends.
  • Establish technology governance, architecture standards, prioritization practices, and a transparent enterprise roadmap.
  • Evaluate and guide major technology investments, platform strategies, sourcing decisions, and vendor partnerships.
  • Ensure technology decisions support mission impact, operational effectiveness, sustainability, and growth.

 

AI Strategy & Digital Innovation
  • Lead Shatterproof's enterprise AI strategy and roadmap.
  • Establish governance frameworks, risk controls, and responsible-use standards for AI technologies.
  • Identify and prioritize AI use cases across fundraising, operations, impact programs, and administration.
  • Lead tool evaluation, pilots, implementation planning, adoption, training, and change management.
  • Monitor emerging technologies and assess opportunities to create measurable organizational value.

 

IT Operations & Workplace Technology
  • Lead IT and workplace technology operations for a distributed workforce.
  • Oversee managed service providers, help desk operations, devices, Microsoft 365, identity and access, collaboration tools, and general application administration.
  • Ensure timely and secure onboarding, offboarding, access management, and technology provisioning.
  • Maintain service standards, knowledge management, policies, procedures, and documentation.
  • Continuously improve reliability, support quality, and the employee technology experience.

 

Cybersecurity, Privacy & Organizational Resilience
  • Lead enterprise cybersecurity strategy, policies, governance, and training.
  • Oversee risk assessments, incident response, cyber insurance requirements, Keeper governance, backups, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.
  • Partner with leaders to protect organizational, employee, donor, constituent, and program data.
  • Monitor emerging risks and drive practical, prioritized mitigation plans.

 

Digital Platforms, Website & Fundraising Technology
  • Lead the strategy, governance, performance, accessibility, analytics, and integrations for Shatterproof's website and digital engagement ecosystem.
  • Oversee fundraising and advocacy technologies, including DonorDrive and New Mode, and related digital vendors.
  • Partner with Development, Marketing & Communications, and Public Affairs to strengthen constituent experience, engagement, and platform value.
  • Oversee Google Analytics and related reporting and optimization capabilities.

 

Salesforce & Enterprise Applications
  • Own the enterprise Salesforce roadmap and governance framework.
  • Oversee administration, security, permissions, data quality, integrations, reporting, releases, user support, and adoption.
  • Partner with department leaders to prioritize enhancements, automation, workflow improvements, and reporting needs.
  • Ensure enterprise applications remain aligned with operational and strategic priorities.

 

Data, Analytics & Business Intelligence
  • Establish organization-wide data governance, reporting standards, and stewardship practices.
  • Oversee dashboards, data models, access, refreshes, data quality, and Power BI capabilities.
  • Partner with leaders to improve data-informed decision-making and performance visibility.
  • Build scalable, well-governed analytics and reporting capabilities.

 

Treatment Atlas Platform & Product Leadership
  • Serve as technology executive sponsor for Treatment Atlas in close partnership with Impact leadership.
  • Oversee current processing infrastructure, operational monitoring, troubleshooting, releases, integrations, data flows, and vendor coordination.
  • Lead the reimagined platform product and technical roadmap, delivery oversight, architecture, cloud strategy, security, and implementation partners.
  • Ensure platform reliability, scalability, security, usability, and long-term sustainability.

 

Technology Financial Management & Vendor Strategy
  • Develop and manage the annual technology budget, forecasts, and multi-year investment plans.
  • Oversee invoices, purchasing, contracts, renewals, licensing, and license optimization.
  • Lead major vendor decisions, negotiations, performance management, and strategic relationships.
  • Develop clear business cases and recommendations for significant technology investments.
  • Oversee the purpose, vendor relationship, users, integrations, renewals, support, and roadmap for Just5, and manage the LegitScript relationship, certifications, submissions, renewals, and organizational obligations.

 

Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing, multidisciplinary technology and digital operations team.
  • Create clarity around roles, decision rights, service ownership, priorities, and cross-functional ways of working.
  • Assess future capability, capacity, structure, and sourcing needs.
  • Build a culture grounded in accountability, service, collaboration, innovation, documentation, and continuous improvement.
  • Communicate complex technology issues in accessible, business-oriented language and lead change with transparency.

 

Ideal Experience & Qualifications
  • 12+ years of progressive leadership experience spanning technology, digital operations, enterprise systems, product management, data, cybersecurity, or related disciplines.
  • Experience serving as the senior technology leader for a complex organization and developing enterprise technology strategies and roadmaps.
  • Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building organizational capability.
  • Strong experience with cybersecurity, technology governance, privacy-supporting controls, risk management, and organizational resilience.
  • Experience leading CRM, data, analytics, digital platforms, enterprise applications, and major technology implementations.
  • Experience overseeing technology budgets, contracts, licensing, vendor relationships, and implementation partners.
  • Experience introducing and scaling AI-enabled solutions, governance, adoption, and training.
  • Ability to translate organizational needs into practical technology priorities, investments, and execution plans.
  • Executive presence and strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to engage technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a mission-driven, distributed, and evolving environment.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience required; advanced degree or relevant certifications preferred.
  • Deep alignment with Shatterproof's mission and values.

CompensationThe salary range for this position is $175,000 to $190,000. Placement within the range is determined by experience, internal equity, and organizational budget.

Additional Information
  • Ability and authorization to work in the United States required.
  • Ability to work Eastern Time Zone hours required.
  • Domestic travel may be required based on organizational needs.
  • Shatterproof is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.
